job_title: 2027 Winter - GRM, Portfolio Risk Data & AI Analyst Intern (4 Months)
job_description:
What is the opportunity?
RBC's Portfolio Risk Oversight (PRO) team within Group Risk Management (GRM) is hiring a Data & AI Analyst Intern for the Winter 2027 term. Our team objectively assess and escalate credit risks across Business and Commercial Banking, deliver detailed portfolio analysis that supports strategic decision-making, maintain best-in-class data capabilities, and respond to ad-hoc data and analytics requests from stakeholders across the organization.

Working hands-on with credit risk and financial data, you will help create and deliver superior risk management insights that grow profitable business, shape prudent risk guidelines and policy, and create sustainable value for RBC shareholders. If you enjoy solving real problems with data, and experimenting with emerging technology, this is a term where your work will be visible and will matter.

What will you do?

- Leverage credit risk and portfolio data to prepare clear, concise and insightful analysis on top and emerging risks and key trends within the BFS portfolio
- Support the preparation of monthly and quarterly risk reporting for various stakeholders, and respond to ad-hoc analytics requests from partners across the business
- Contribute to automation and modernization initiatives that make our reporting and analytics faster, more reliable and easier to consume
- Build hands-on skills across the full data lifecycle — extraction, transformation, aggregation, interpretation and recommendation — and grow your understanding of how credit risk data drives business decisions
- Participate in analytics design sessions: contribute ideas, gather and document business requirements, and help shape the analytical framework behind effective risk management reporting
- Explore and apply emerging industry-leading tools and methods — including generative AI — to solve problems in new ways, and share what you learn across the team


Must-have

- Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance or Economics)
- Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and data accuracy
- Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with the ability to query, manipulate and analyze large datasets
- Working knowledge of a data visualization tool such as Tableau, and an instinct for presenting data clearly
- Ability to draw conclusions from complex data and communicate them in plain business language to non-technical partners
- Strong MS Office skills, particularly Excel (advanced formulas and data manipulation), PowerPoint and Word
- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to balance recurring reporting deadlines against ad-hoc requests
- Intellectual curiosity and a self-starter mindset — comfortable asking questions and learning new tools quickly


Nice-to-have

- Familiarity with the financial services industry, or exposure to credit risk concepts
- Hands-on experience with generative AI or LLM tools, including effective prompt engineering, and an interest in how AI agents and MCP integrations can be applied to real work
- Familiarity with building HTML-based or web dashboards
- Exposure to large-scale enterprise data environments, such as an Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Enterprise Data Lake (EDL) or Hadoop-based platforms


Please note:
This posting is for a 4-months Winter 2027 Student placement with a start date of January 2027, and end date of April 2027. In order to be eligible for this 4-months Student position, you must either:


- Be returning back to school after the work term end-date of April 2027 ; or
- If you are not returning back to school (i.e. are graduating in April 2027), you must require the full 4-months work term as a mandatory component to in order to graduate successfully.


RBC is committed to supporting flexible work arrangements when and where available. The successful candidate for this role will be required to be located within Ontario for the duration of the work term. Details regarding the specific virtual, hybrid, and in-office arrangements for this Integrated Learning/ Co-op position are to be discussed with the Hiring Manager.

Company: CGIC



Department: Claims



Employment Type: Regular Full-Time



Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)



Language: Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.



The Opportunity



We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.



Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. We are passionate about continuous improvement and operate with high-integrity, motivated by our desire to do the right thing for our clients.



As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.



How You Will Create Impact





- Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
- Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
- Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
- Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
- Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
- Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.







To Join Our Team





- You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
- You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
- ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
- You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.

- You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
- Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
- Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks







How You Will Succeed





- You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
- You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
- Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
- You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.







What You Need To Know





- You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.







What’s in it for you?




- Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
- Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
- A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
- Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
- In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.







Salary information



Expected Salary range : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD



The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.



Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

job_description:
Established in 2004, we are a tech pioneer offering world-class adult entertainment and games on some of the internet’s safest and most popular platforms. With the support of an international team of dynamic and collaborative innovators, we are on a mission to enable safe user experiences and empower our communities by celebrating diversity, inclusion, and expression — all while maintaining robust trust-and-safety protocols.



We embrace the best of both worlds! Local talent can thrive in our collaborative office space with the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, while remote team members play an integral role in shaping our dynamic culture from afar. We have offices in Montreal (Quebec), Austin (Texas) and Nicosia (Cyprus).




- A select number of positions require full-time in office attendance*





The Data Warehouse Services team plays a vital role in our organization. They are responsible for storing vast quantities of data from many sources and responsible for disseminating data across the organization to various different groups. They are one of the backbones of data at our organization and they are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join their team.



What you'll be doing:





- Collaborate with internal stakeholders including; Directors, Analysts, and Developers to understand business objectives and requirements, and help define the strategy, content, and features for our reporting environments.

- Engage with business partners at all levels to discuss and clarify data analysis, needs and requirements.

- Analyze data structures and content from data marts to support business intelligence initiatives.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment, where multitasking and adaptability are essential.

- Participate in brainstorming sessions to define functional requirements, organize content, map process flows, and specify report features.

- Develop and optimize queries to investigate data issues or new reporting structures for various business units.

- Work closely with Database Administrators and Developers to estimate time and effort for report projects and refining these estimates throughout the project.

- Collaborate with Project Managers to track project status, identify potential risks,and resolve issues as they arise.

- Become a subject matter expert in relevant business domains and reporting tools.

- Assist in coordinating and maintaining development roadmaps to ensure alignment with business goals.






What you'll need to be successful:



Must Haves:





- 5+ years of experience in a similar role.
- Knowledge of tools to create, extract, and analyze from SQL Server / Excel / PowerBI / Fabric / Cubes.

- Strong customer support experience.
- Understanding Data flow Concepts.
- Understanding Business Model Concepts.

job_description:
Data Security & DLP Analyst (AI Training)



About The Role



At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build and train frontier AI models. We're looking for data security professionals who understand how real data leaks happen — and can bring that knowledge to one of the most consequential technology challenges of our time.



Your expertise in DLP controls, data classification, and security operations will directly shape how AI systems reason about sensitive information, exposure risk, and data protection. This is a rare opportunity to apply deep security knowledge in a cutting-edge AI context — on your own schedule, from anywhere.




- Organization: Alignerr
- Type: Hourly Contract
- Location: Remote
- Commitment: 10–40 hours/week





What You'll Do





- Analyze realistic data security and DLP scenarios across cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments
- Classify data sensitivity levels, exposure paths, and policy violations with precision
- Evaluate prevention, detection, and incident response strategies for real-world applicability
- Generate, label, and validate data security cases used to train and benchmark AI systems
- Help AI models develop accurate, nuanced understanding of how sensitive information risk plays out in modern organizations





Who You Are





- 2+ years of experience in data security, compliance, security operations, or a related field
- Solid familiarity with DLP tools, data classification frameworks, and privacy or regulatory concepts (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA)
- Practical, hands-on understanding of how data risk manifests in real enterprise environments
- Strong analytical thinking and ability to communicate complex scenarios in structured, clear formats
- Self-motivated and comfortable working independently on task-based assignments





Nice to Have





- Experience with cloud security platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) or SaaS security controls
- Background in security engineering, GRC, or insider threat programs
- Familiarity with AI workflows or data annotation projects





Why Join Us





- Work directly on frontier AI systems built with top research labs
- Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work at your own pace
- Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
- Put your real-world security expertise to work on problems that matter
- Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Our Story
Notre parcours

A propos de vous :

Vous etes une personne performante qui cherche a s'accomplir dans un environnement dynamique. Vous valorisez la croissance personnelle et professionnelle et etes pret a faire le prochain pas dans l'avancement de votre carriere.



Si cela vous ressemble, vous aimerez la culture chez Avison Young !



A propos de nous :

Avison Young est une agence internationale de courtage et de consultation en immobilier commercial, proposant des services transactionnels, financiers, consultatifs et de gestion. Nous avons concu notre structure corporative de facon a mieux servir nos clients en renforcant la collaboration dans toute notre organisation.



L'immobilier peut avoir des effets positifs enormes sur la vie des gens, et nous nous employons a creer des lieux et des espaces qui sieront mieux aux gens. Notre raison d'etre, c'est de creer une reelle valeur economique, sociale et environnementale, portee par des gens fiers.



Bien sur, nous adorons etre ici, mais les gens de l'externe nous trouvent tres bien aussi ! Avison Young a ete nommee comme l'une des societes les mieux gerees au Canada 13 annees consecutives, avec designation du Club Platine!



______________



About You:You are a high achiever looking to thrive in a fast-paced environment. You take pride in your own work but are comfortable collaborating with a team of highly motivated individuals. You can communicate clearly and concisely with teammates and clients, and you enjoy strong company culture and camaraderie. You can navigate multiple corporate functions, including global lines of service and corporate centers of excellence. You possess strong interpersonal skills and are willing to take on diverse tasks to achieve the team's common goal. You value personal and professional growth and are ready to take the next step in advancing your career.If this sounds like you, well, then you will love the culture at Avison Young!About Us:Avison Young is a global commercial real estate brokerage and advisory firm, offering transaction, management, financial and consulting services. We've designed our corporate structure to best serve our clients by enhancing collaboration across our organization.Real estate can have an enormous positive impact on people's lives - and we're in the business of making spaces and places work better for people. Our purpose is to create real economic, social and environmental value as a global real estate advisor, powered by people.We care about each other and we have each other's backs. This makes Avison Young a great place to be a client, and a great place to work. We support the whole person and their complete wellness - economic, mental and physical - because what's best for our business comes from our people bringing their whole selves to work.

Of course we love it here, but outsiders think we're pretty great too! Avison Young has been recognized as one of Canada's Best Managed Companies for the 13th year in a row, with a Platinum Club designation!

Overview
A titre d'analyste de donnees au sein de l'equipe Intelligence de marche d'Avison Young, vous contribuerez a transformer les donnees immobilieres en informations strategiques qui soutiennent la prise de decision dans les marches immobiliers commerciaux, tant a l'echelle locale que nationale.



Dans ce role, vous serez responsable de la gestion, de la validation, de l'analyse et de l'enrichissement des donnees au sein des plateformes technologiques d'Avison Young. Vous travaillerez avec un vaste eventail de donnees liees a l'immobilier commercial, notamment les immeubles, les transactions de location, les ventes d'actifs, ainsi que les donnees economiques, demographiques et de marche. Votre travail appuiera les priorites de votre marche local tout en contribuant a des initiatives nationales en collaboration avec des collegues partout au Canada.

En plus d'assurer l'integrite et la qualite des donnees, vous participerez a l'analyse des tendances qui faconnent les marches des bureaux, de l'industriel, du commerce de detail et de l'investissement immobilier. Vous contribuerez egalement a des projets visant a ameliorer les plateformes technologiques et a accroitre les capacites analytiques de l'entreprise.



Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion pour une personne curieuse et analytique qui souhaite evoluer a l'intersection des donnees, de la technologie et de l'immobilier commercial. Vous serez expose(e) a l'une des industries les plus dynamiques au pays tout en contribuant a la production d'informations qui influencent les decisions de location, d'investissement et de developpement immobilier.

______________



As a Data Analyst on Avison Young's Market Intelligence team, you will help turn commercial real estate data into insights that support decision-making across local and national markets.



In this role, you will manage, validate, analyze, and enhance data within Avison Young's technology platforms, working with a wide range of commercial real estate information, including property, leasing, investment, economic, demographic, and market data. Your work will support local business priorities while contributing to national initiatives and collaborating with colleagues across Canada.



From tracking market activity and improving data quality to identifying trends in office, industrial, retail, and investment markets, you will play a hands-on role in helping real estate professionals and clients make informed, data-driven decisions. You will also contribute to projects that strengthen Avison Young's technology platforms and expand the firm's market intelligence capabilities.



This is an excellent opportunity for a curious and analytical problem-solver who wants to combine data, technology, and commercial real estate. You'll gain exposure to one of Canada's most dynamic industries while helping shape the insights that drive leasing, investment, and development decisions.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

In addition to serving as the organization’s primary analytical strategist, this role provides critical support to Finance through the development of accurate, timely financial reports, performance analyses, and forecasting inputs. Data Governance and Infrastructure


- Establish and maintain enterprise data governance frameworks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity across operational and financial systems

Strategic Initiatives

Qualifications & Skills

- Excellent communication skills, able to clearly present complex analyses to non-technical stakeholders

26WD100492, Principal Data Analyst



Position Overview



Autodesk has invested in data-driven decision-making, optimizing our platform’s business, product, and cost. The next five years will transform how we work, with a surge in data volume and scaling of AI/ML to provide even greater value to our customers. We are looking for a Principal Data Analyst to serve as a senior individual contributor and trusted thought partner to Product, Engineering, Strategy, Research, and business leaders. You will define how success is measured, uncover high-value opportunities, lead rigorous experimentation, and build trusted analytical products and AI assisted workflows that turn complex data into better decisions at scale.



This role combines deep product analytics judgment, strong SQL/Python capability, software engineering discipline, and practical fluency with modern AI tools. You will operate comfortably in ambiguity, influence product direction, and create reusable systems that increase the leverage of teams across the organization.



If you are excited about empowering teams and influencing the organization with insights that drive success, this is the role for you!



Responsibilities





- Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to identify, define, and address business problems and opportunities through data analysis
- Use your analytical skills to derive actionable insights from large and complex datasets and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner to technical and non-technical audiences
- Define product measurement across north-star metrics, KPI/OKR frameworks, metric trees, instrumentation, guardrails, and launch measurement for platform initiatives
- Use AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate SQL/Python development, automate repeatable analytical work, prototype lightweight data applications or assistants, and create reusable workflows with appropriate validation, provenance, and human review
- Create clear and impactful data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar, to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization
- Build and evolve canonical datasets, semantic models, metric definitions, dashboards, and self-service experiences that can be reliably consumed by both people and AI systems
- Proactively mine for data drive insights to support PSET's platform outcomes, focusing on performance, user engagement, and overall business impact
- Partner with Data Engineering on data quality, lineage, observability, and scalable pipelines; use version control, testing, code review, and reproducible development practices for high-value analytical assets
- Communicate complex findings as concise decisions and trade-offs for technical and executive audiences; mentor analysts and cross-functional partners on problem framing, experimentation, AI-assisted analytics, and data storytelling





Minimum Qualifications





- 8+ years of experience in large data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment
- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Demonstrated principal/staff level scope: independently shaping ambiguous problems, influencing product roadmaps, and driving decisions across multiple teams
- Hands on experience using AI assisted development and analysis tools (Claude Code, Cursor etc.) to accelerate coding, automate workflows, prototype tools, or extend beyond traditional analyst workflows
- Strong skills in data querying and manipulation with SQL, and proficiency in programming languages like Python or R for data analysis and modeling. Experience with data warehouse ELT tools (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)
- Experience with semantic layers, governed metric definitions, and BI/visualization tools such as Looker or Power BI, with a track record of enabling trustworthy self-service analytics
- Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to work independently on complex datasets and derive actionable insights
- Knowledge of statistical techniques and modeling methodologies to drive in-depth data insights and support predictive analytics
- Strong ability to communicate complex data insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner
- Effective team player with a strong ability to work across functions, engage with diverse stakeholders, and provide data-driven support for strategic initiatives





Preferred Qualifications





- Prior experience working in a SaaS company or a platform engineering organization is preferred
- Familiarity with Autodesk’s product portfolio and its applications in various industries is an advantage
- Experience analyzing AI/ML or agentic products, including evaluation frameworks and quality, task success, latency, reliability, or cost trade-offs
- Experience building lightweight internal data products, analytical applications, or LLM enabled tools connected to governed enterprise data
- Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline





26WD100492, Analyste principal des données



Aperçu du Poste



Autodesk s’est engagé dans une démarche de prise de décision fondée sur les données, visant à optimiser les activités, les produits et les coûts de notre plateforme. Les cinq prochaines années vont transformer notre façon de travailler, avec une explosion du volume de données et une généralisation de l’IA et du ML afin d’apporter encore plus de valeur à nos clients. Nous recherchons un analyste de données principal qui jouera le rôle de collaborateur senior et de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des responsables des produits, de l’ingénierie, de la stratégie, de la recherche et des dirigeants de l’entreprise. Vous définirez les indicateurs de réussite, identifierez les opportunités à forte valeur ajoutée, mènerez des expérimentations rigoureuses et développerez des outils analytiques fiables ainsi que des flux de travail assistés par l’IA, capables de transformer des données complexes en meilleures décisions à grande échelle.



Ce poste allie un sens aigu de l’analyse produit, de solides compétences en SQL et Python, une rigueur en ingénierie logicielle et une maîtrise pratique des outils modernes d’IA. Vous serez à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, influencerez l’orientation des produits et créerez des systèmes réutilisables qui renforceront l’efficacité des équipes à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.



Si vous êtes motivé(e) par l’idée de donner les moyens d’agir aux équipes et d’influencer l’organisation grâce à des informations qui favorisent la réussite, ce poste est fait pour vous !



Responsabilités





- Collaborer avec les chefs de produit et les équipes transversales pour identifier, définir et traiter les problèmes et opportunités métier par le biais de l’analyse de données
- Utiliser vos compétences analytiques pour tirer des enseignements exploitables à partir d’ensembles de données volumineux et complexes, et communiquer vos conclusions de manière claire et concise à un public technique et non technique
- Définir les mesures de performance des produits à travers les indicateurs phares, les cadres KPI/OKR, les arborescences de métriques, l’instrumentation, les garde-fous et les mesures de lancement pour les initiatives de la plateforme
- Utiliser des outils de codage et d’analyse basés sur l’IA pour accélérer le développement en SQL/Python, automatiser les tâches analytiques récurrentes, prototyper des applications ou des assistants de données légers, et créer des flux de travail réutilisables avec validation, traçabilité et révision humaine appropriées
- Créer des visualisations de données claires et percutantes à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI, Looker ou similaires, afin de communiquer les conclusions et les recommandations aux parties prenantes de toute l’organisation
- Construire et faire évoluer des ensembles de données canoniques, des modèles sémantiques, des définitions de métriques, des tableaux de bord et des expériences en libre-service pouvant être exploités de manière fiable tant par les utilisateurs que par les systèmes d’IA
- Exploiter de manière proactive les données pour en tirer des enseignements permettant de soutenir les résultats de la plateforme PSET, en mettant l’accent sur la performance, l’engagement des utilisateurs et l’impact global sur l’activité
- Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données sur la qualité des données, la traçabilité, l’observabilité et les pipelines évolutifs ; utiliser le contrôle de version, les tests, la revue de code et des pratiques de développement reproductibles pour les actifs analytiques à forte valeur ajoutée
- Communiquer des conclusions complexes sous forme de décisions concises et de compromis à l’intention d’un public technique et de direction ; encadrer les analystes et les partenaires interfonctionnels sur la formulation des problèmes, l’expérimentation, l’analyse assistée par l’IA et la mise en valeur des données





Qualifications Minimales





- Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans l’analyse de grandes quantités de données, la business intelligence ou un domaine connexe, de préférence dans un environnement technologique ou SaaS
- Licence dans un domaine quantitatif tel que la science des données, les statistiques, les mathématiques ou une discipline connexe. Capacité avérée à agir au niveau d’un responsable ou d’un cadre : cerner de manière autonome des problèmes ambigus, influencer les feuilles de route des produits et piloter les décisions au sein de plusieurs équipes
- Expérience pratique de l’utilisation d’outils de développement et d’analyse assistés par l’IA (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) pour accélérer le codage, automatiser les flux de travail, prototyper des outils ou aller au-delà des flux de travail traditionnels des analystes
- Solides compétences en interrogation et manipulation de données avec SQL, et maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python ou R pour l’analyse et la modélisation des données. Expérience avec les outils ELT de data warehouse (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)
- Expérience avec les couches sémantiques, les définitions de métriques gouvernées et les outils de BI/visualisation tels que Looker ou Power BI, avec une expérience avérée dans la mise en place d’analyses en libre-service fiables
- Capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes avérées, avec la capacité de travailler de manière autonome sur des ensembles de données complexes et d’en tirer des enseignements exploitables
- Connaissance des techniques statistiques et des méthodologies de modélisation pour obtenir des analyses approfondies des données et soutenir l’analyse prédictive
- Grande capacité à communiquer des informations complexes issues des données et des recommandations aux parties prenantes techniques et non techniques de manière claire et accessible
- Esprit d’équipe efficace, avec une forte capacité à travailler de manière transversale, à interagir avec des parties prenantes diverses et à apporter un soutien fondé sur les données pour les initiatives stratégiques





Qualifications Souhaitées





- Une expérience préalable au sein d’une entreprise SaaS ou d’une organisation d’ingénierie de plateformes est souhaitée
- La connaissance du portefeuille de produits d’Autodesk et de ses applications dans divers secteurs est un atout

Ce poste est idéal pour les nouveaux diplômés et les professionnels en début de carrière qui sont analytiques, rigoureux et désireux de développer une expertise en opérations de prêt, gestion des risques, service à la clientèle et transactions financières.





À propos de cette opportunité





À titre d’Analyste des opérations bancaires, vous soutiendrez les activités de financement hypothécaire de type
warehouse lending ainsi que les opérations de gestion des prêts, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes, les clients, les dépositaires et les équipes opérationnelles. Communicate product updates, advancements, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role.

Experience with Agile methodology and backlog management is considered an asset.

Working knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) and data warehouse concepts and terminology.

Experience with tools and platforms such as Power BI, Snowflake, Lucidchart, Collibra, Tableau, Dataiku, or similar solutions.

Hands on experience with SAP ECC, SAP S/4, and EWM, MM, and TMS modules.

Proven experience in business and technical requirements analysis, modeling, verification, and methodology development.

Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Self motivated and able to work effectively in an open and collaborative team environment.

Continuous improvement and innovation mindset.

Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects while meeting deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to connect the dots and tell compelling stories using data.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Enthusiasm for new technologies.

job_description:
Medisca est une entreprise mondiale qui s’appuie sur des partenariats solides pour servir les professionnels de la santé dans diverses disciplines liées au bien-être. En proposant des solutions complètes et essentielles, y compris des ingrédients et des services pharmaceutiques, la fabrication de technologies de mélange, des tests analytiques et la formation, Medisca comble les lacunes en matière de soins de santé grâce à un engagement inébranlable en faveur de la précision, de l’innovation et de l’impact sociétal.



L’analyste d’affaires fera le pont entre les besoins d’affaires et les systèmes d’entreprise essentiels de Medisca — notamment les plateformes CRM et ERP — au sein d’une organisation réglementée et multi-entités. Ce rôle consiste à diriger la collecte des exigences, la cartographie des processus et la conception de solutions pour les projets de mise en œuvre, d’amélioration et d’intégration de systèmes, en collaboration étroite avec les TI, les opérations et les parties prenantes d’affaires, afin de s’assurer que nos plateformes répondent à de véritables besoins d’affaires plutôt que de simplement automatiser les inefficacités existantes.



L'opportunité



Responsabilités Et Fonctions :





- Diriger les séances de collecte et d’élicitation des exigences avec les parties prenantes des ventes, des opérations, des finances, de l’entrepôt et du service à la clientèle pour les initiatives CRM et ERP
- Documenter les processus d’affaires actuels et futurs, incluant les cartes de processus, les diagrammes de flux de travail et les analyses d’écarts
- Traduire les exigences d’affaires en spécifications fonctionnelles exploitables par les équipes de développement et de configuration
- Collaborer avec les équipes CRM et ERP afin de définir la portée des améliorations, des intégrations et des efforts de migration de données
- Soutenir les projets de mise en œuvre de systèmes de bout en bout : découverte, conception, planification et exécution des tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT), formation et stabilisation post-lancement
- Identifier et documenter les points d’intégration et les flux de données entre le CRM, l’ERP et les systèmes adjacents
- Faciliter les décisions de conception entre les priorités concurrentes des parties prenantes et documenter clairement les compromis et leur justification
- Assurer la responsabilité de la planification des UAT : conception des cas de test, triage des anomalies et approbation des parties prenantes
- Soutenir la gestion du changement ainsi que la formation et la documentation des utilisateurs finaux pour les nouveaux processus et changements de systèmes
- Maintenir la documentation des processus d’affaires et la traçabilité des exigences à travers les projets
- Contribuer à la gouvernance de projet : rapports d’état, suivi des risques et enjeux, et communication avec les parties prenantes





Qualifications:





- Baccalauréat, ou expérience équivalente, en administration des affaires, systèmes d’information ou domaine connexe
- 4 ans ou plus d’expérience à titre d’analyste d’affaires au soutien de systèmes CRM et/ou ERP d’entreprise
- Expérience pratique avec au moins une plateforme CRM majeure et une plateforme ERP majeure; solides compétences en modélisation des processus d’affaires (p. ex. BPMN, diagrammes de couloirs); expérience avérée dans la gestion des UAT; excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale; capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanés et des priorités concurrentes. Une expérience dans une industrie réglementée, dans des déploiements multi-entités, avec une méthodologie de migration de données, ou une certification en analyse d’affaires (p. ex. CBAP, CCBA) constitue un atout
- Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Teams, Excel) exigée; expérience avec des plateformes CRM/ERP un atout
- Souci du détail et sens des responsabilités; compétences avérées en prise de décision et en résolution de problèmes; capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans des initiatives transversales et ambiguës; orientation vers les solutions, avec la capacité de remettre en question, de façon constructive, une solution demandée qui ne répond pas au besoin d’affaires sous-jacent





Ce que cela vous apporte...



Nous investissons du temps et des ressources pour nous assurer que Medisca est à la hauteur des personnes que nous embauchons.




- Équilibre vie professionnelle/vie personnelle - Semaine de travail de 37,50 heures avec des vendredis qui terminent plus tôt toute l'année, politique de congés payés et de vacances.
- Investissez dans votre santé - Choix de plans modulaires, compte de dépenses de santé et télémédecine gratuite.
- Votre bien-être est important – Programme bien-être offert
- Environnement de travail flexible - Horaire de travail hybride avec programme de remboursement du bureau à domicile.

Pay Range: CAD 80-90/hr

The Cloud First Business Analyst serves as the governance analyst and documentation lead for the Cloud First Program. Working under the direction of the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead, the role documents governance entities defines inputs and outputs, models governance processes, and develops the artefacts required to operationalize the Cloud First governance framework.





Purpose of the Role

The role identifies information requirements, analyses governance needs, documents agreed outcomes, develops governance artefacts, and models end-to-end processes. Stakeholder engagement, workshop coordination, meeting management, communications, approval follow-up, and final governance decisions remain with the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead.





Key Responsibilities





1. Governance Operating Model

· Support the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead in finalizing the definition of all Cloud First governance entities.

· Document the purpose, scope, responsibilities, authority, decision rights, membership, and cadence of each governance entity.

· Maintain the governance catalogue and operating model.





2. Inputs and Outputs Definition

· Define and document the inputs required by each governance entity.

· Define outputs, decisions, approvals, actions, and artefacts produced by each governance entity.

· Produce governance interaction models that show information flows between governance bodies.





3. Governance Process Definition

· Work with the Program Technical Lead to define the processes executed within each governance entity.

· Document process objectives, triggers, activities, approvals, decision points, and outcomes.

· Apply consistent documentation standards across the programme.





4. Process Modelling and Repository Management · Develop clear process maps and flowcharts for governance processes.

· Document workflow dependencies, approvals, escalations, and hand-offs.

· Maintain the governance process repository and supporting artefacts.





Responsibility Boundaries

The Business Analyst supports analysis and documentation, but is not accountable for:

· Arranging workshops or meetings

· Managing stakeholder communications

· Scheduling sessions or maintaining calendars · Chasing stakeholders for feedback · Securing approvals · Owning governance decisions





These activities remain the responsibility of the Cloud First Program Management Team, with support and direction from the Program Technical Lead.





Required Skills and Competencies

· Strong business analysis, requirements analysis, and structured documentation skills.

· Experience documenting governance operating models, decision rights, RACI matrices, and escalation frameworks.

· Proficiency in process mapping, workflow analysis, and modelling dependencies, approvals, and hand-offs.

· Ability to translate complex governance discussions into clear, consistent, and usable artefacts.

· Strong written communication, attention to detail, version control, and repository management.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with programme management, technical leads, and governance stakeholders.





Preferred Experience and Tools

· Experience supporting cloud transformation, cloud adoption, technology governance, or enterprise change programmes.

· Working knowledge of common process-modelling methods and tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent.

· Experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration and documentation tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.

· Understanding of governance controls, approval workflows, decision logs, and document lifecycle management.





Education and Experience

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

· Business analysis or process-modelling certification is advantageous.

· Relevant experience level to be aligned with the organization’s role-grading and project requirements.





Success Measures

· Governance artefacts are complete, accurate, consistent, traceable, and ready for review and approval.

· Process models clearly show triggers, activities, decision points, approvals, escalations, dependencies, and outcomes.

· Governance repositories remain current, controlled, and easy for stakeholders to navigate.

· Deliverables are completed in line with agreed programme priorities and documentation standards

📧 ANDY.WETTLAUFER@RANDSTADDIGITAL.COM

high value post-campaign reporting that derives insights

- Participate in campaign optimization sessions and support analysis of campaign performance
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams achieve campaign objectives in the stated timelines
- Utilize strong project management skills to drive initiatives from conception to completion within established timelines
- Continuously improve campaign design and delivery by leveraging any and all analytical tools/techniques at your disposal
- Execute with excellence

- Maintain a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes and sound infrastructure

- A project management mindset to help deliver on time to specifications

L’Analyste financier principal, BI et rapports financiers

Ce poste soutient les rapports financiers complexes, la budgétisation, les prévisions, l’intelligence d’affaires et les initiatives stratégiques, tout en encadrant les analystes juniors et en dirigeant des projets de transformation à fort impact.



Principales responsabilités

Compétences clés

- Excellentes aptitudes analytiques et de communication.

Relations clés

Senior Financial Analyst, BI Reporting



At IPEX, the leader in thermoplastic piping systems, we are redefining the future of water management and clean energy. Guided by our values – We Dare, We Care, We Deliver – we challenge the status quo to make a meaningful impact. Technical Skills

Key Relationships





- Collaborates with Finance, Accounting, Operations, and IT teams.
- Partners with business unit leaders to provide financial insights and recommendations.
- Supports ERP and BI system administrators during upgrades and transitions.





Why Join Us?



This role offers the opportunity to influence business growth, develop strategic customer partnerships, and contribute directly to market expansion within a respected industry-leading organization.

Description Du Poste



Clientèle

- Maintenir de bonnes relations avec la clientèle en résolvant les problèmes et en expliquant les processus d’affaires afin de répondre aux demandes.
- Interagir, au besoin, avec d’autres partenaires ou fournisseurs, leur fournir des conseils ou répondre à leurs questions et préoccupations de façon efficace et en temps opportun.





Actionnaires




- Établir les priorités et gérer sa charge de travail afin de respecter les exigences de service et de productivité prévues dans les SLA.
- Maintenir une bonne compréhension des réglementations internes et du secteur, surveiller les tendances, partager ses connaissances concernant les nouveaux enjeux et risques, et évaluer les répercussions possibles sur les politiques, normes et procédures opérationnelles.

- Participer à l’élaboration ou à la mise en œuvre de normes, politiques, procédures et solutions visant à atténuer les risques et à maximiser l’accessibilité, l’efficacité et la qualité du service.

- Soutenir l’équipe en développant continuellement ses connaissances opérationnelles, en analysant de façon critique les processus et les possibilités d’amélioration, en partageant des idées et des connaissances au sein de l’équipe, de la fonction et avec les partenaires.
- Offrir de la formation, du mentorat ou du soutien à d’autres membres de l’équipe.
- Participer à la gestion du rendement et à son propre développement professionnel, notamment par la formation croisée au sein de son équipe et d’autres équipes opérationnelles.

- Tenir les parties concernées informées de l’état d’avancement des projets ainsi que de toute information pertinente liée aux activités quotidiennes.
- Contribuer à la réussite de l’équipe en aidant volontairement les autres à accomplir leurs tâches et en fournissant au besoin de la formation, du mentorat ou des conseils.
- Contribuer à un environnement de travail équitable, positif et inclusif qui favorise la diversité.
- Agir à titre d’ambassadeur ou d’ambassadrice de la fonction et de la Banque, tant à l’interne qu’à l’externe.





Portée et complexité du poste




- Travaille dans un environnement comportant des paramètres larges ou non standard, impliquant plusieurs étapes, systèmes et territoires, où les pratiques du marché peuvent être peu définies, avec recours à un niveau supérieur au besoin.

À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.





Ce que nous offrons


- ** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
- Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
- Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
- Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
- Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
- Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
- 3 semaines de vacances par année.
- 5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
- Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
- Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
- Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
- La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.






Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.





Responsabilités


- Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
- Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
- Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
- Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
- Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
- Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.






Exigences


- D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
- 2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
- Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
- Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
- Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
- Bilinguisme français et anglais.
- Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.






La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.





--





About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.





What We Offer


- ** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
- 100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
- Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
- Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
- Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
- A MacBook computer on your first day.
- 3 weeks vacation.
- 5 personal days to use at your discretion.
- A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
- The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
- A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.






About The Role

job_description:
Role description


Job Title: Senior Data Scientist- AI/ML Engineering



Location: Canada



Job Summary:

You will work as a forward deployed data scientist: embedded with enterprise clients, turning ambiguous business problems into working analytical and AI solutions, and staying with the work until it runs in their environment. This is a hands-on senior role. You will own problems end to end — scoping with stakeholders, wrangling messy client data, choosing methods that fit the constraints, building the solution, and handing it off in a state another team can operate.



Some engagements need something built from scratch. Many do not — the work is adopting, configuring and extending what already exists: our own products and accelerators, the client’s current platform, or a vendor tool. We are looking for people who are comfortable either way, who can tell which situation they are in, and who would rather extend a working solution than rebuild it.



We are looking for modern technical builders rather than notebook-only analysts: fluent with Python, SQL, Git, cloud and cloud data platforms, AI-native in how they work, credible in front of a client, and pragmatic about when a simple method is enough and when deeper modelling is warranted.



Education and background: a quantitative degree — statistics, computer science, engineering, operations research, economics, mathematics, physics, or similar. A master’s is preferred. A PhD is welcome but not expected. A strong bachelor’s candidate is equally of interest where there is clear evidence of applied delivery.



What You Will Do



• Partner directly with client stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical problems — and push back when the framing is wrong.



• Build reliable analytical assets on messy enterprise data: forecasting, optimization, ML, statistical models, and the pipelines around them.



• Just as often, work with what is already there — configure and extend our existing products and accelerators, or the client’s existing tools, rather than rebuilding from scratch.



• Put something in a stakeholder’s hands early — a prototype app, a dashboard, a clear analysis — and iterate from real feedback.



• Ship code others can reuse: tested, documented, reproducible, reviewed.



• Work alongside data engineers and ML engineers through to deployment, rather than throwing work over the wall.



• Use LLMs and AI coding tools to move faster, while keeping statistical judgment and final review your own.



• Raise the level of the people around you: review work and mentor less experienced colleagues.



Required



Engineering & Tooling



• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, at a level where your code goes to other people rather than only into your own notebook.



• Comfortable with Git, pull requests, code review, terminal workflows, package management, and reproducible environments.



• Working experience on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and with a modern data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Spark, or equivalent.



• Able to turn exploratory analysis into reusable, tested, and documented code.



• Comfortable working inside an existing codebase or product as well as starting from a blank page — reading someone else’s code, understanding how it works, and extending it without breaking it.



• Able to independently troubleshoot common data, query, environment, and pipeline issues — failed jobs, broken queries, bad joins, package conflicts, data-quality problems — without immediately requiring an engineer.



Data Science

• Strong practical data science skills, including working with messy enterprise data and translating business problems into actionable analysis.



• Working knowledge of forecasting, optimization, machine learning, and statistical methods — with the judgment to know when a simple method is sufficient, and the discipline to validate honestly (proper backtesting and out-of-time validation for time series, not just a random train/test split).



• Able to answer “did this actually work?” with defensible evidence: experiment design and read-out, or quasi-experimental methods when a clean test is not possible.



• Regular user of LLMs or AI coding tools for coding, analysis, debugging, testing, and documentation, while maintaining independent judgment. You should be able to explain what AI output you accepted, rejected, rewrote, and tested, and how you spot output that is plausible but wrong.



• Basic understanding of production data/ML concepts, including pipelines, data quality, reproducibility, versioning, deployment, and monitoring.



Delivery and Client Work

• Able to take an ambiguous request from a business stakeholder and turn it into a scoped piece of work, with a view on what is feasible in the time available.



• Able to clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, findings, and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders — in writing and in the room.



• Able to make results usable: a lightweight app or dashboard (for example Streamlit, Dash, Plotly, or a BI tool) or a clean, well-argued document, depending on what the audience needs.

job_description:
Data Scientist (Masters) — AI Model Trainer



About The Role



What if your expertise in machine learning, statistical inference, and data engineering could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason through complex problems? We're looking for data scientists with advanced degrees to challenge, audit, and refine cutting-edge AI models — helping them think more rigorously, reason more accurately, and perform at a higher level.



This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI industry experience required — just deep domain knowledge and a sharp analytical mind.




- Organization: Alignerr
- Type: Hourly Contract
- Location: Remote
- Commitment: 10–40 hours/week





What You'll Do





- Design Advanced Challenges: Develop complex, domain-specific data science problems spanning hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross-validation strategies, dimensionality reduction, and more — problems that genuinely push AI reasoning to its limits
- Author Ground-Truth Solutions: Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions including Python and R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as authoritative reference answers
- Audit AI-Generated Code: Evaluate AI outputs using libraries like Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow — assessing them for technical accuracy, efficiency, and correctness
- Identify and Document Failure Modes: Catch logical errors in AI reasoning such as data leakage, overfitting, and improper handling of imbalanced datasets, then provide structured feedback that improves model behaviour
- Refine Model Reasoning: Help shape how AI models approach statistical and algorithmic problems by documenting every meaningful failure and guiding iterative improvements





Who You Are





- Currently pursuing or have completed a Master's or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field with a strong data analysis focus

job_description:
Who are we?



Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.



We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.



We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.



We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Why this role?



We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most curious people to help us do it. As a Data Scientist on our Analytics and Data Insights team, you'll work on problems that don't have textbook answers yet; building the analytics that shape product and company strategy, designing the experiments that prove or kill our biggest bets, and helping enterprise customers understand what foundational AI actually means for their bottom line. You'll own analytical work end-to-end: from framing the right questions and building the models to shipping insights, tools, and results that product leaders, sales teams, and enterprise customers rely on.



As a Data Scientist, You Will





- Drive the mission forward.
- Build bleeding-edge agentic analytics: Agentic analytics is far from a solved problem, and we want to be the company that solves it. We need the sharpest minds with the curiosity, drive, and focus required to build the tools necessary to bring order and clarity to real world data.
- Define AI impact measurement: own the end-to-end analytics story around adoption, growth, and impact that North leadership uses to prioritize features by measured value rather than customer feedback alone.
- Ship customer-facing analytics: insights that our enterprise customers recognize as evidence of value created.
- Build small language models to categorize, classify, and enrich message data to give customers visibility into how their teams are using our products in their enterprise.
- Design and run experiments: A/B tests, causal inference studies, and opportunity sizing that directly map to product and go-to-market decisions.
- Build predictive models that matter: develop and deploy models for forecasting, segmentation, propensity scoring, and opportunity sizing across Cohere's core business lines.
- Act like an owner: no waiting around. You'll define analytical priorities within your scope, push initiatives from question to production, and own what you build.





You May Be a Good Fit, If You Have





- Strong command of SQL, Python, and Git, alongside expertise in statistical inference, experimental design, and predictive modeling
- A proven ability to turn ambiguous business questions into rigorous analytical problems, with clear and compelling recommendations to match
- Experience building and deploying production models, not just notebook analysis. You know what it takes to get a classifier down the stack from prototype to production volume.
- Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as BigQuery, dbt, Looker, or Airflow (nice to have, not essential)
- Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and enjoy being in the weedsComfort operating in ambiguity, managing multiple workstreams across different stakeholders, and distilling insights into a concise, actionable narrative
- A collaborative style grounded in empathy as much as in data; you work alongside product, research, sales, and finance, not in a silo





If some of the above doesn't line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!



Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks





- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
- Annual enrichment benefits:





Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.



Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.




- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.





How And Where We Work





- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.





If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.



We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our
official careers page.

Our pension offerings provide flexibility and long-term security for our employees beyond their careers. We are one of the few companies offering the opportunity to receive guaranteed income for life via our defined benefit pension plan.



Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented above is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.



About The Role



Intact is looking for a Data Scientist to turn complex data into practical solutions (prediction, segmentation, optimization, automation) and to generate actionable insights.



Within the Data Lab, you will work in a modern data ecosystem with multidisciplinary teams (data science, analytics, engineering, product) on high-impact end-to-end use cases (anomaly detection, personalization, experimentation, etc.).



The Lab emphasizes rigor (quality, validation, performance monitoring, continuous improvement), collaboration with business and engineering teams, and value-driven innovation, including generative AI and LLMs to speed up access to information, automate processes, and deliver responsible, measurable solutions in production.



What You'll Do Here





- Develop innovative solutions: Use machine learning and advanced statistical methods to identify trends and patterns in complex datasets.
- Data transformation: Turn complex databases into actionable insights and recommendations that can guide business strategy.
- Stay up to date: Keep abreast of the latest trends and methodologies in data science and integrate them into your work.
- Tool and platform maintenance: Help maintain and improve our data mining tools and platforms to ensure their efficiency and reliability.
- Actionable recommendations: Provide strategic recommendations based on data analysis to support decision-making processes.
- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with other departments to promote the adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization.
- Quality assurance and mentoring: Validate the quality of analytical approaches and deliverables produced by the team to ensure high standards, while coaching less experienced members.
- Technical leadership: Take on a technical leadership role, guiding the team on best practices in data science and identifying research and development opportunities.





What You Bring To The Table





- A master’s degree in a relevant field (mathematics, science, engineering, operations research, economics, statistics, AI, computer science, or a related discipline), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- At least 5 years of experience in data science, machine learning, and advanced statistics applied to solving business problems.
- Machine learning expertise: Expert-level understanding of machine learning theories and methodologies.
- Specialization: Expertise in one or more areas such as computer vision, natural language processing, or artificial intelligence.
- Technical skills: Experience delivering to production across multiple platforms using the following commercial and open-source data mining frameworks and tools: R, Python, GitHub.
- Team spirit: Strong enthusiasm for collaborative teamwork.
- Problem-solving: Ability to tackle loosely defined problems with creative and innovative solutions.
- Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information to non-technical stakeholders.
- Time management: Strong organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.
- Bilingual (French and English): Need to interact on a regular basis with an English-speaking clientele and colleagues across the country.

- No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada

Data Scientist (Masters) — AI Model Trainer



About The Role



What if your expertise in machine learning, statistical inference, and data engineering could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason through complex problems? We're looking for data scientists with advanced degrees to challenge, audit, and refine cutting-edge AI models — helping them think more rigorously, reason more accurately, and perform at a higher level.



This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI industry experience required — just deep domain knowledge and a sharp analytical mind.




- Organization: Alignerr
- Type: Hourly Contract
- Location: Remote
- Commitment: 10–40 hours/week





What You'll Do





- Design Advanced Challenges: Develop complex, domain-specific data science problems spanning hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross-validation strategies, dimensionality reduction, and more — problems that genuinely push AI reasoning to its limits
- Author Ground-Truth Solutions: Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions including Python and R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as authoritative reference answers
- Audit AI-Generated Code: Evaluate AI outputs using libraries like Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow — assessing them for technical accuracy, efficiency, and correctness
- Identify and Document Failure Modes: Catch logical errors in AI reasoning such as data leakage, overfitting, and improper handling of imbalanced datasets, then provide structured feedback that improves model behaviour
- Refine Model Reasoning: Help shape how AI models approach statistical and algorithmic problems by documenting every meaningful failure and guiding iterative improvements





Who You Are





- Currently pursuing or have completed a Master's or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field with a strong data analysis focus
- Solid foundational knowledge across core areas such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop), or NLP
- Able to communicate highly technical concepts — algorithmic logic, statistical results, mathematical derivations — clearly and precisely in written form
- Naturally detail-oriented: you catch errors in code syntax, mathematical notation, and statistical reasoning that others miss
- Self-directed and comfortable working independently on technical tasks
- No prior AI or data annotation experience required





Nice to Have





- Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or model evaluation systems
- Proficiency in production-level data science workflows such as MLOps or CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models
- Familiarity with prompt engineering or working with large language models
- Experience writing technical documentation or academic-style explanations of complex methods





Why Join Us





- Work directly with industry-leading AI research teams and language models at the frontier of the field
- Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you, on your own schedule
- Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, technically rigorous work
- Make a direct, measurable impact on how the next generation of AI understands and applies data science
- Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
