Job Description



Role Overview



The Data Scientist II will be responsible for developing, validating, and optimizing internal fraud and authentication models that support TD's objective of expanding proprietary risk capabilities and reducing reliance on external vendor models. The role covers the end-to-end model development lifecycle, including data discovery, feature engineering, experimentation, model evaluation, documentation, business impact assessment, and productionization support.



This is a hands-on development role with significant responsibility for presenting results and communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The successful candidate will partner with Strategy, Engineering, Product, Data, Model Validation, and Risk teams to translate business challenges into scalable analytical solutions.



Key Responsibilities





- Develop, validate, and optimize machine learning and statistical models for fraud detection, authentication, identity verification, account opening, account takeover, scam detection, and related risk use cases.

- Lead end-to-end model development activities, including data discovery, exploratory analysis, data preparation, feature engineering, experimentation, model training, hyperparameter tuning, performance evaluation, and business impact assessment.

- Evaluate internal models against vendor models and existing business strategies, using appropriate fraud and risk metrics such as capture rate, false-positive rate, lift, precision, recall, stability, and customer friction.

- Build reproducible and well-documented analytical workflows using Python, SQL, and enterprise data platforms, and support implementation and productionization with Engineering, FICO, MLOps, and platform teams.

- Perform model monitoring, stability and segmentation analysis, performance diagnostics, and issue investigation to identify degradation, data gaps, and remediation actions.

- Prepare model documentation and analytical evidence for Model Validation, Model Risk Management, governance reviews, approvals, and lifecycle management.

- Analyze customer, authentication, and fraud behaviour to identify emerging trends, risk gaps, feature opportunities, and areas where internal models can improve detection coverage.

- Prepare and deliver executive-ready presentations, technical documentation, reports, and business impact summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Lead cross-functional discussions to align stakeholders on data requirements, model scope, success criteria, risks, dependencies, timelines, implementation considerations, and next steps.

- Contribute to continuous improvement of internal modeling standards, reusable analytical frameworks, development practices, and proprietary fraud and authentication capabilities.






Qualifications Required





- Undergraduate or graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

- 3-5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or advanced analytics.

- Strong hands-on proficiency in Python, SQL, machine learning, statistical analysis, feature engineering, and data visualization.

- Experience developing and evaluating predictive models in a business or production-oriented environment.

- Strong presentation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to explain technical methods, model results, limitations, and business impact to different audiences.

- Ability to independently manage development activities across multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.






Preferred / Strong Assets





- Previous experience with Model Validation (MV), model risk, model governance, or independent model review processes.

- Experience in fraud analytics, authentication, cybersecurity, financial crime, identity verification, or digital banking.

- Experience developing fraud, risk, or customer behaviour models using highly imbalanced datasets.

- Experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, MLOps pipelines, Streamlit, FICO platforms, or other cloud-based analytics environments.

- Experience supporting model implementation, production deployment, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management.

- Familiarity with graph analytics, network analysis, or advanced AI techniques is an asset.

job_description:
About Agoda



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.



Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.



Get To Know Our Team:



Join a small platform team building the next generation of natural-language analytics at Agoda. You will own the governed knowledge layer between our data warehouse and the applications, assistants, and analysts that consume it: metrics, domain context, quality signals, and the APIs that expose them. This is semantic modeling and knowledge engineering, not dashboard reporting or model training.



The Opportunity:





- You will design and operate the shared knowledge layer behind conversational analytics at Agoda: turning scattered business knowledge into versioned, reviewable assets that return consistent, current answers.
- You pair with a senior tech lead on product architecture. Your scope is the layer itself (models, context, validation, governance workflows) and how it is exposed through service and agent interfaces.





What You’ll Do:





- Model governed metrics, dimensions, joins, and grain for business domains
- Structure expert context, glossaries, and validated question patterns as Git-reviewed assets
- Build freshness, drift, and validation signals; treat stale knowledge as a production issue
- Expose the layer through APIs so applications and agents get deterministic answers
- Enable domain owners to propose, review, and publish knowledge without engineering deploys
- Partner across analytics, product, and platform teams on access control and quality standards





Required Qualifications:





- 4+ years in BI, analytics engineering, data platform, or software engineering with heavy data modeling
- Semantic or metrics-layer experience (LookML, dbt metrics, or equivalent)
- Strong SQL and analytical modeling on OLAP / warehouse systems
- Knowledge engineering: versioned definitions, peer review, contributor workflows
- API / service mindset: you design for multiple consumers, not a single dashboard

job_description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About The Role:



CrowdStrike is looking for a Principal Data Engineer with deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI platforms to join our growing Data Science Platform Engineering Team. You will be a key leader, responsible for designing, building, and deploying cutting-edge data infrastructure that powers our next generation of AI-driven security products. This role requires significant hands-on experience in LLM integration, agentic workflows, and agent harnessing to deliver high-impact, scalable solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, focusing on shipping fast, writing elegant, high-quality code, and actively mentoring and strengthening the team's technical knowledge and capabilities.



The scale of our systems and data are approaching Exabytes in size. Experience with extremely large-scale systems, including DevSecOps patterns, practices, and standards are important for this work.



What You'll Do:





- Architect, implement, and optimize data platforms and pipelines specifically designed to support LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and sophisticated AI agentic systems at Exabyte scale.
- Drive the adoption and deployment of agentic workflows and agent harnessing techniques to create autonomous, data-driven security features.
- Design and implement highly scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective data solutions, emphasizing rapid iteration and high-quality deployment.
- Write elegant, production-ready code with a focus on performance, maintainability, and testing rigor, ensuring the ability to ship fast without compromising quality.
- Provide technical leadership and deep expertise in data modeling, normalization, and semantic cataloging for AI/ML workloads.
- Establish best practices for MLOps/DataOps surrounding LLMs, including monitoring, observability, and zero-touch recovery mechanisms for AI services.
- Actively mentor engineers, conducting technical workshops, leading design reviews, and strengthening the team's knowledge in cutting-edge AI platform technologies.
- Collaborate across the organization with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and other engineering teams to transform research prototypes into robust, production-grade services.
- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical data services: development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.





Tech Stack (Expertise In Several Key Areas Is Expected):





- MLOps Tools (MLflow, Sagemaker, Vertex AI)
- Experience with common agentic workflow frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
- Expert-level proficiency in a high-level coding language (Python, or JVM technologies).
- Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Dask, Flink).
- Strong expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and related data services.
- Containerization and orchestration mastery (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Message queuing and streaming technologies (Kafka, Pulsar).
- Data Warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery) and Data Orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow).





What You'll Need:





- Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 10+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering/Platform Engineering, with at least 3 years focused on architecting and building platforms for AI/ML or Data Science at massive scale.
- Demonstrable hands-on experience in LLM engineering (fine-tuning, prompt engineering, deployment), RAG, and developing agentic workflows.
- Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems (sharding, partitioning, concurrency).
- Exceptional ability to write clean, elegant, performant, and well-tested code, coupled with a proactive mindset for delivering results quickly.
- A thorough understanding of engineering practices, including effective peer code reviews, resilient architecture design, and comprehensive testing paradigms.
- Prior experience in a Principal or Staff level engineering role, demonstrating technical leadership and mentorship capabilities.
- Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary + performance bonuses
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

job_description:
EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary + performance bonuses
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

Northbeam’s Data Science organization serves as the intelligence layer of the company, owning the end-to-end science behind marketing measurement and optimization. Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.

Position overview

Every creator and platform that works with Stay22 relies on clear, trustworthy data to understand whether their content and traffic are creating value. In this role, you will help make that picture reliable. You will join a small but high-impact Data & Analytics team and work across three squads: Hub, where partners sign up, manage their accounts and track performance; Integrations, which connects supplier and partner data; and Social, which helps creators turn social content into revenue opportunities.

This is a true analytics role, not a position limited to dashboard production. You will turn ambiguous product and business questions into analysis and recommendations, validate data quality and limitations, and help teams make better decisions. You will use SQL, Python, funnels, cohorts, experimentation and dashboards, while bringing curiosity, asking thoughtful questions and owning problems from the first question through to the next step.

Key responsibilities

• Partner with Product Managers, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to support product and business initiatives through data.
• Turn unclear questions into clear hypotheses, success metrics and analysis plans.
• Support product experiments and A/B tests by validating setup, defining KPIs and analyzing results.
• Deliver end-to-end analysis for Hub, Social and Integrations, using funnels, cohorts, segmentation, retention and other practical methods.
• Build, maintain and improve dashboards, recurring reports and trusted metrics.
• Validate data quality by checking definitions, duplicates, missing events, freshness and differences between sources.
• Present findings, limitations and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Help teams become more self-sufficient in using data and interpreting results through documentation, clear definitions and reusable analysis.
• Partner with Data Engineering to improve data quality and analytical workflows without owning ETL architecture or infrastructure.

Requirements

• At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, growth analytics, strategy, insights or a related field.
• Strong SQL skills and experience owning analyses from clarifying the question through validation, interpretation and recommendation.
• Experience with BI or visualization tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or a comparable platform.
• Practical Python experience for data cleaning, exploration, automation, prototyping or working with larger datasets.
• A solid understanding of statistics, metric definition, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, experimentation and A/B testing.
• Strong data-quality judgment, including the ability to identify anomalies, missing events, duplicates, inconsistent definitions and limitations across sources.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into practical recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Curiosity, autonomy and comfort asking questions, working through ambiguity, adapting to changing priorities and validating AI-assisted analysis when used.

What to expect during our hiring process

We know your time is valuable, here is a quick look at the next steps:

• Call with our Talent Acquisition Advisor (30 min).
• Interview with the hiring manager (45 min).
• Technical interview and live case with members of the Data team and a Product partner (60 min).
• Final interview with our CEO (30 min).
• Offer and onboarding 🎉

Note: this process may evolve based on the team's needs.

Why join Stay22?

• Prime Montreal Location: Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.
• Comprehensive Benefits: Health & dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass’, and regular team socials, events, and retreats.
• Flexibility That Works: Flexible schedules, work-from-anywhere opportunities, year-end shutdown, and flex days.

Aperçu du poste

Chaque créateur et chaque plateforme qui travaille avec Stay22 dépend de données claires et fiables pour comprendre si son contenu et son trafic génèrent de la valeur. Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras à rendre cette lecture fiable. Tu rejoindras une équipe Data & Analytics à taille humaine et à fort impact, et tu travailleras avec trois squads : Hub, où les partenaires s’inscrivent, gèrent leur compte et suivent leur performance; Integrations, qui relie les données des fournisseurs et des partenaires; et Social, qui aide les créateurs à transformer leur contenu social en opportunités de revenus.

Il s’agit d’un véritable rôle en analytique, et non d’un poste limité à la création de tableaux de bord. Tu transformeras des questions produit et business ambiguës en analyses et recommandations, tu évalueras la qualité des données et leurs limites, et tu aideras les équipes à prendre de meilleures décisions. Tu utiliseras SQL, Python, les analyses de conversion et de cohortes, l’expérimentation et les tableaux de bord, tout en faisant preuve de curiosité, en posant de bonnes questions et en prenant en charge les problèmes de la première question jusqu’à la prochaine étape.

Principales responsabilités

• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produit, les ingénieurs et les parties prenantes de différentes équipes pour soutenir les initiatives produit et d’affaires grâce aux données.
• Transformer des questions peu précises en hypothèses claires, indicateurs de succès et plans d’analyse.
• Soutenir les expérimentations produit et les tests A/B en validant leur mise en place, en définissant les KPI et en analysant les résultats.
• Mener des analyses de bout en bout pour Hub, Social et Integrations, à l’aide d’entonnoirs, de cohortes, de segmentation, de rétention et d’autres méthodes pratiques.
• Construire, maintenir et améliorer les tableaux de bord, les rapports récurrents et les indicateurs fiables.
• Vérifier la qualité des données en contrôlant les définitions, les doublons, les événements manquants, la fraîcheur des données et les écarts entre les sources.
• Présenter clairement les constats, les limites et les recommandations à des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
• Aider les équipes à devenir plus autonomes dans l’utilisation et l’interprétation des données grâce à une bonne documentation, des définitions claires et des analyses réutilisables.
• Collaborer avec Data Engineering pour améliorer la qualité des données et les méthodes d’analyse, sans être responsable de l’architecture ETL ou de l’infrastructure.

Expérience recherchée

• Expérience avec des outils de BI ou de visualisation comme Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou une plateforme comparable.
• Expérience pratique avec Python pour nettoyer et explorer des données, automatiser des tâches, créer des prototypes ou travailler avec de grands volumes de données.
• Bonne compréhension des statistiques, de la définition des métriques, de l’analyse d’entonnoirs, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’expérimentation et des tests A/B.
• Bon jugement en matière de qualité des données, notamment pour repérer les anomalies, les événements manquants, les doublons, les définitions incohérentes et les limites entre différentes sources.
• Excellentes aptitudes de communication et capacité à transformer une analyse complexe en recommandations concrètes pour des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
• Curiosité, autonomie et aisance à poser des questions, à avancer dans l’ambiguïté, à s’adapter aux priorités changeantes et à valider les analyses assistées par l’IA lorsque nécessaire.

EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary + performance bonuses
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

Northbeam’s Data Science organization serves as the intelligence layer of the company, owning the end-to-end science behind marketing measurement and optimization. You will work at the intersection of R&D and product, owning modeling end-to-end: from data exploration and experimental design to model validation, production integration, and live system iteration. You will bring a deep understanding of statistical modeling techniques and, critically, the assumptions underlying them. This role requires strong judgment in selecting, stress-testing, and adapting models to real-world marketing data where ideal conditions rarely exist.
This is a high-agency, hands-on role, requiring comfort shifting between deep technical work, cross-functional collaboration, and customer-facing problem solving as business needs evolve.
Enhance the accuracy, robustness, and scalability of existing MMM pipelines.
Write production-quality Python and SQL, collaborating closely with Engineering to integrate statistical workflows into scalable systems.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Canada's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.
• Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools
• Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources
• Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning
• Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
• Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g., Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary + performance bonuses
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

job_description:
Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth.
We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We're a remote-friendly company with offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.
About the Data Science Organization

Northbeam’s Data Science organization serves as the intelligence layer of the company, owning the end-to-end science behind marketing measurement and optimization. This includes developing and advancing our core methodologies—Media Mix Modeling (MMM), Incrementality testing, causal multi-touch attribution (MTA), calibration and validation frameworks, and large-scale experimentation systems. The team is also responsible for AI-driven insights, recommendations, and the creation of reusable, scalable, and rigorously validated scientific systems that power Northbeam’s product and customer value.
We are seeking a Staff Data Scientist to advance the statistical and experimentation foundations of Northbeam’s marketing intelligence products, including MMM, Incrementality, Insights, and Recommendation engines. This is a full-stack data scientist role, operating across the entire lifecycle—from researching and developing advanced statistical and causal inference approaches to implementing, deploying, and maintaining production systems.
You will work at the intersection of R&D and product, owning modeling end-to-end: from data exploration and experimental design to model validation, production integration, and live system iteration. You will bring a deep understanding of statistical modeling techniques and, critically, the assumptions underlying them. This role requires strong judgment in selecting, stress-testing, and adapting models to real-world marketing data where ideal conditions rarely exist.
This is a high-agency, hands-on role, requiring comfort shifting between deep technical work, cross-functional collaboration, and customer-facing problem solving as business needs evolve.
Enhance the accuracy, robustness, and scalability of existing MMM pipelines.
Write production-quality Python and SQL, collaborating closely with Engineering to integrate statistical workflows into scalable systems.
Debug data and modeling issues in production and improve the reliability of customer-facing results.
Translate complex statistical reasoning into clear, decision-ready insights for internal stakeholders and customers.
Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, or a highly quantitative STEM field (Master’s preferred).
• 6+ years of applied experience in data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling roles.
• Deep applied experience in statistics and causal inference, including hands-on ownership of experiment design (A/B testing, geo-based experiments, or quasi-experimental methods), power analysis, and interpretation of lift.
• Experience translating statistical research or experimentation frameworks into production-ready systems.
• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working on modern data platforms and statistical modeling libraries.
• Experience working with production code and comfort making changes to live models and pipelines.
• Thrives in a small, fast-paced environment, with the ability to drive projects end-to-end.
• Strong communication skills, with comfort explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences and supporting customer-facing investigations.
• A growth mindset and genuine curiosity about improving measurement quality and decision-making.

Bonus Skills & Experience

Experience with optimization techniques (e.g., linear programming, mixed-integer programming) applied in production systems.
Familiarity with MLOps practices and data pipeline orchestration tools.
PhD in a quantitative field.
Unlike most Series A+ companies, we have a proven business model, strong revenue, and a growing waitlist of customers eager for the products we’re building. We sit at the center of the performance-marketing ecosystem with deep partnerships across major ad platforms (Meta, Snap, TikTok, AppLovin, and more). Our unique combination of high-quality partner integrations, rich 1st-party data, and a robust identity graph gives us an advantage that is extremely difficult for competitors to replicate.
Northbeam is where top-tier data talent can directly shape the industry’s most important measurement challenges at scale.
#LI-Remote
In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder.

job_description:
EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

job_description:
Data Architect – Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS)Organization: Government of Alberta

Ministry: Environment & Protected Areas

Location: Remote (Must reside and work within Canada; Mountain Time Zone)

Position Type: Contract (GoA Standard Contingent, initial term with up to 24-month extension)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:15 AM – 4:30 PM MT (36.25 hrs/week)

About the Role: The Government of Alberta is modernizing how it regulates and assures environmental outcomes across the province. Central to this transformation is the Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS), an enterprise platform supporting applications, approvals, compliance, and monitoring activities to protect Alberta's air, land, water, and biodiversity. We are seeking a senior Data Architect to design and lead data integration among DRAS, our Databricks-based Data Management Platform, and the Alberta Geospatial Platform.

In this role, you will set the target-state architecture and govern the flow of regulatory, environmental, and spatial data. You will join an agile, multidisciplinary delivery team that includes data engineers, software developers, GIS specialists, business analysts, and product owners.

Key Responsibilities Architecture & Design

• Define and maintain the target-state architecture integrating DRAS, the Databricks Lakehouse, and the Alberta Geospatial Platform.
• Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for regulatory, environmental, and geospatial domains.
• Establish enterprise integration patterns (batch, near-real-time, event-driven, API, and Change Data Capture).
• Design Databricks Lakehouse structures, including medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold layers), Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog governance.
• Architect spatial data pipelines that maintain geometry, coordinate reference systems, and spatial accuracy across platforms.
Integration & Agile Delivery
• Lead pipeline and interface designs in close collaboration with data engineers and developers.
• Define data contracts, interface agreements, and API specifications.
• Resolve integration challenges surrounding data quality, latency, schema drift, and system dependencies.
• Participate in agile ceremonies and translate high-level architecture into actionable user stories.
Governance, Security & Quality
• Operationalize data governance standards, including data lineage, metadata catalogs, master/reference data, and data classification.
• Ensure all designs adhere to Government of Alberta policies, cybersecurity baselines, and FOIP (Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy) standards.
• Implement data quality frameworks, validation rules, and automated monitoring across integration boundaries.
• Define and enforce Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC) based on data classification levels.
Leadership & Advisory
• Serve as the principal data architecture advisor to executive leadership, product owners, and technical teams.
• Align technical architectures with enterprise roadmaps across government ministries.
• Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), blueprint diagrams, and technical specifications.
• Provide technical mentorship to team members.
Qualifications
Education

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Geomatics, or a related discipline.
Mandatory Experience
• Enterprise Architecture: Minimum 8 years designing, planning, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions.
• Data Architect Experience: Minimum 8 years acting in a Data Architect capacity within large, complex enterprise IT environments.
• Database Documentation & Modeling: Minimum 8 years documenting enterprise database systems and relational/dimensional data models.
• Enterprise Best Practices: Minimum 8 years applying enterprise architecture frameworks and principles.
• Threat & Risk Assessments (TRA): Minimum 6 years performing security TRAs and delivering risk-mitigation recommendations.
• Leadership & Strategy: Demonstrated track record leading technical architecture initiatives, resource/effort estimation, and executive stakeholder presentations.
• Databricks Ecosystem: Hands-on technical experience designing solutions using Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark (PySpark/SQL), and Unity Catalog.
• Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Data Lake Storage, Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault).
• Integration Patterns: Proven track record implementing REST APIs, ETL/ELT, event streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC).
• Geospatial & Public Sector: Practical experience integrating geospatial datasets and familiarity with government/regulatory environments.
Preferred Assets & Certifications
• TOGAF Certification (The Open Group Architecture Framework).
• Prior experience with the Government of Alberta (GoA) architecture and IT environments (5+ years strongly preferred).
• Experience with ServiceNow platform data integration.
• Hands-on experience with architecture modeling tools (e.g., SAP Power Designer, ER/Studio).
• 4+ years of project delivery using Agile/Scrum frameworks.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server database development, SQL Data Warehousing, and Transact-SQL (T-SQL).
Remote Work & Technical Requirements
• Location Requirement: 100% remote. The contractor must perform all work within Canada.
• Contractor-Supplied Equipment: The contractor/supplier is solely responsible for supplying their own hardware (Windows-based PC/laptop capable of running modern enterprise remote access software, monitors, peripherals) and high-speed internet.
• Security & Access: The Province will provision secure login credentials and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) access.
• Background Clearance: Selected candidates must successfully pass a criminal record check prior to contract start.
• Mandatory Training: Successful candidates must complete provincial compliance training during onboarding (including FOIP, Cybersecurity, and Respect in the Workplace).
Evaluation Criteria
Candidate submissions are evaluated on a 100-point scale:

• Interview: 60%
• Resource Qualifications & Experience: 35%
• Financial / Rate Proposal: 5%

job_description:
Data Architect – Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS)Organization: Government of Alberta

Ministry: Environment & Protected Areas

Location: Remote (Must reside and work within Canada; Mountain Time Zone)

Position Type: Contract (GoA Standard Contingent, initial term with up to 24-month extension)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:15 AM – 4:30 PM MT (36.25 hrs/week)

About the Role: The Government of Alberta is modernizing how it regulates and assures environmental outcomes across the province. Central to this transformation is the Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS), an enterprise platform supporting applications, approvals, compliance, and monitoring activities to protect Alberta's air, land, water, and biodiversity. We are seeking a senior Data Architect to design and lead data integration among DRAS, our Databricks-based Data Management Platform, and the Alberta Geospatial Platform.

In this role, you will set the target-state architecture and govern the flow of regulatory, environmental, and spatial data. You will join an agile, multidisciplinary delivery team that includes data engineers, software developers, GIS specialists, business analysts, and product owners.

Key Responsibilities Architecture & Design

• Define and maintain the target-state architecture integrating DRAS, the Databricks Lakehouse, and the Alberta Geospatial Platform.
• Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for regulatory, environmental, and geospatial domains.
• Establish enterprise integration patterns (batch, near-real-time, event-driven, API, and Change Data Capture).
• Design Databricks Lakehouse structures, including medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold layers), Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog governance.
• Architect spatial data pipelines that maintain geometry, coordinate reference systems, and spatial accuracy across platforms.
Integration & Agile Delivery
• Lead pipeline and interface designs in close collaboration with data engineers and developers.
• Define data contracts, interface agreements, and API specifications.
• Resolve integration challenges surrounding data quality, latency, schema drift, and system dependencies.
• Participate in agile ceremonies and translate high-level architecture into actionable user stories.
Governance, Security & Quality
• Operationalize data governance standards, including data lineage, metadata catalogs, master/reference data, and data classification.
• Ensure all designs adhere to Government of Alberta policies, cybersecurity baselines, and FOIP (Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy) standards.
• Implement data quality frameworks, validation rules, and automated monitoring across integration boundaries.
• Define and enforce Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC) based on data classification levels.
Leadership & Advisory
• Serve as the principal data architecture advisor to executive leadership, product owners, and technical teams.
• Align technical architectures with enterprise roadmaps across government ministries.
• Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), blueprint diagrams, and technical specifications.
• Provide technical mentorship to team members.
Qualifications
Education

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Geomatics, or a related discipline.
Mandatory Experience
• Enterprise Architecture: Minimum 8 years designing, planning, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions.
• Data Architect Experience: Minimum 8 years acting in a Data Architect capacity within large, complex enterprise IT environments.
• Database Documentation & Modeling: Minimum 8 years documenting enterprise database systems and relational/dimensional data models.
• Enterprise Best Practices: Minimum 8 years applying enterprise architecture frameworks and principles.
• Threat & Risk Assessments (TRA): Minimum 6 years performing security TRAs and delivering risk-mitigation recommendations.
• Leadership & Strategy: Demonstrated track record leading technical architecture initiatives, resource/effort estimation, and executive stakeholder presentations.
• Databricks Ecosystem: Hands-on technical experience designing solutions using Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark (PySpark/SQL), and Unity Catalog.
• Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Data Lake Storage, Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault).
• Integration Patterns: Proven track record implementing REST APIs, ETL/ELT, event streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC).
• Geospatial & Public Sector: Practical experience integrating geospatial datasets and familiarity with government/regulatory environments.
Preferred Assets & Certifications
• TOGAF Certification (The Open Group Architecture Framework).
• Prior experience with the Government of Alberta (GoA) architecture and IT environments (5+ years strongly preferred).
• Experience with ServiceNow platform data integration.
• Hands-on experience with architecture modeling tools (e.g., SAP Power Designer, ER/Studio).
• 4+ years of project delivery using Agile/Scrum frameworks.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server database development, SQL Data Warehousing, and Transact-SQL (T-SQL).
Remote Work & Technical Requirements
• Location Requirement: 100% remote. The contractor must perform all work within Canada.
• Contractor-Supplied Equipment: The contractor/supplier is solely responsible for supplying their own hardware (Windows-based PC/laptop capable of running modern enterprise remote access software, monitors, peripherals) and high-speed internet.
• Security & Access: The Province will provision secure login credentials and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) access.
• Background Clearance: Selected candidates must successfully pass a criminal record check prior to contract start.
• Mandatory Training: Successful candidates must complete provincial compliance training during onboarding (including FOIP, Cybersecurity, and Respect in the Workplace).
Evaluation Criteria
Candidate submissions are evaluated on a 100-point scale:

• Interview: 60%
• Resource Qualifications & Experience: 35%
• Financial / Rate Proposal: 5%

Ministry: Environment & Protected Areas

Position Type: Contract (GoA Standard Contingent, initial term with up to 24-month extension)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:15 AM – 4:30 PM MT (36.25 hrs/week)

About the Role: The Government of Alberta is modernizing how it regulates and assures environmental outcomes across the province. Central to this transformation is the Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS), an enterprise platform supporting applications, approvals, compliance, and monitoring activities to protect Alberta's air, land, water, and biodiversity. We are seeking a senior Data Architect to design and lead data integration among DRAS, our Databricks-based Data Management Platform, and the Alberta Geospatial Platform.

In this role, you will set the target-state architecture and govern the flow of regulatory, environmental, and spatial data. You will join an agile, multidisciplinary delivery team that includes data engineers, software developers, GIS specialists, business analysts, and product owners.

Key Responsibilities Architecture & Design

• Define and maintain the target-state architecture integrating DRAS, the Databricks Lakehouse, and the Alberta Geospatial Platform.
• Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for regulatory, environmental, and geospatial domains.
• Establish enterprise integration patterns (batch, near-real-time, event-driven, API, and Change Data Capture).
• Design Databricks Lakehouse structures, including medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold layers), Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog governance.
• Architect spatial data pipelines that maintain geometry, coordinate reference systems, and spatial accuracy across platforms.
Integration & Agile Delivery
• Lead pipeline and interface designs in close collaboration with data engineers and developers.
• Define data contracts, interface agreements, and API specifications.
• Resolve integration challenges surrounding data quality, latency, schema drift, and system dependencies.
• Participate in agile ceremonies and translate high-level architecture into actionable user stories.
Governance, Security & Quality
• Operationalize data governance standards, including data lineage, metadata catalogs, master/reference data, and data classification.
• Ensure all designs adhere to Government of Alberta policies, cybersecurity baselines, and FOIP (Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy) standards.
• Implement data quality frameworks, validation rules, and automated monitoring across integration boundaries.
• Define and enforce Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC) based on data classification levels.
Leadership & Advisory
• Serve as the principal data architecture advisor to executive leadership, product owners, and technical teams.
• Align technical architectures with enterprise roadmaps across government ministries.
• Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), blueprint diagrams, and technical specifications.
• Provide technical mentorship to team members.
Qualifications
Education

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Geomatics, or a related discipline.
Mandatory Experience
• Enterprise Architecture: Minimum 8 years designing, planning, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions.
• Data Architect Experience: Minimum 8 years acting in a Data Architect capacity within large, complex enterprise IT environments.
• Database Documentation & Modeling: Minimum 8 years documenting enterprise database systems and relational/dimensional data models.
• Enterprise Best Practices: Minimum 8 years applying enterprise architecture frameworks and principles.
• Threat & Risk Assessments (TRA): Minimum 6 years performing security TRAs and delivering risk-mitigation recommendations.
• Leadership & Strategy: Demonstrated track record leading technical architecture initiatives, resource/effort estimation, and executive stakeholder presentations.
• Databricks Ecosystem: Hands-on technical experience designing solutions using Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark (PySpark/SQL), and Unity Catalog.
• Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Data Lake Storage, Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault).
• Integration Patterns: Proven track record implementing REST APIs, ETL/ELT, event streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC).
• Geospatial & Public Sector: Practical experience integrating geospatial datasets and familiarity with government/regulatory environments.
Preferred Assets & Certifications
• TOGAF Certification (The Open Group Architecture Framework).
• Prior experience with the Government of Alberta (GoA) architecture and IT environments (5+ years strongly preferred).
• Experience with ServiceNow platform data integration.
• Hands-on experience with architecture modeling tools (e.g., SAP Power Designer, ER/Studio).
• 4+ years of project delivery using Agile/Scrum frameworks.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server database development, SQL Data Warehousing, and Transact-SQL (T-SQL).
Remote Work & Technical Requirements
• Location Requirement: 100% remote. The contractor must perform all work within Canada.
• Contractor-Supplied Equipment: The contractor/supplier is solely responsible for supplying their own hardware (Windows-based PC/laptop capable of running modern enterprise remote access software, monitors, peripherals) and high-speed internet.

Evaluation Criteria
Candidate submissions are evaluated on a 100-point scale:

job_title: Senior Data Analyst - French/English Proficiency Required
job_description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst – French/English Proficiency Required based in Canada. This is a data-driven role focused on turning complex information into actionable insights that improve products, customer experiences, and business performance. You will work across business intelligence, product analytics, partner-facing analytics, and AI-enabled workflows. The position offers broad exposure to Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership teams. You will also engage directly with business customers, presenting findings and recommendations in both French and English. Your work will help identify growth opportunities, improve funnels and engagement, strengthen reporting, and support better business decisions. You will combine analytical expertise with modern tools such as SQL, dbt, BI platforms, Python, and AI-powered technologies. This is an opportunity to contribute to an evolving analytics function where curiosity, clear communication, experimentation, and practical business impact are highly valued. Accountabilities: - Business Intelligence & Reporting: Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical tools using platforms such as Looker, Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, or similar technologies. - Business Insights: Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to deliver analysis that informs strategic and operational decisions. - Product Analytics: Analyze customer and user behavior across activation, conversion, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption to identify opportunities and performance trends.

- Funnel & Performance Analysis: Identify product opportunities, friction points, funnel drop-offs, and emerging trends using appropriate analytical methods, while contributing to metric definitions and performance tracking. - Reporting Automation: Automate recurring reports and data workflows using SQL, dbt, and lightweight scripting tools such as Python, R, Google Apps Script, or similar technologies. - Data Quality: Support the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting pipelines, data marts, dashboards, and underlying analytical data. - Partner-Facing Analytics: Develop custom data solutions and insights for business customers, including presenting findings, explaining analysis, answering questions, and identifying opportunities in both French and English. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Finance, Data, and Software Engineering teams to support analytics projects and improve the reliability and commercial value of data. - AI-Enabled Analytics: Use modern AI tools and APIs, including platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or comparable solutions, to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, and improve stakeholder self-service. - AI Experimentation & Validation: Explore use cases such as natural-language data analysis, automated insight generation, data-quality checks, opportunity identification, and workflow automation while validating AI outputs for accuracy, privacy, and business relevance. - Analytics Community: Share best practices, contribute to analytics initiatives and forums, and stay informed about emerging developments in data analytics and AI. Requirements - Professional Experience: 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related field. - Language Proficiency: Business-level fluency in both French and English is required, with the ability to communicate effectively in professional, cross-functional, and client-facing settings. - Client-Facing Skills: Comfortable presenting insights, explaining analytical findings, answering questions, and engaging directly with business customers.

Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role

• Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
• Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
• Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
• Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
• Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
• Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
• Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
• Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
• Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
• Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.

About You

• You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
• You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
• Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
• You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
• You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
• You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
• You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
• You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
• You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.
