Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com.

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

About The Role

Peek is looking for a curious, product-minded, and data-driven Data Analyst – Analytics, AI, and Customer Insights to help turn data into meaningful insights, reporting, and business improvements.

In this role, you’ll work across business intelligence, product analytics, partner-facing analytics, and AI-enabled workflows. You’ll support internal teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership, while also helping deliver insights directly to Peek’s business customers.

This is a role for someone who is comfortable working with data, communicating clearly, and translating complex analysis into practical recommendations. Because this role may involve working directly with English and French speaking customers, the ideal candidate must be fully fluent in both French and English and comfortable participating in client-facing conversations, presentations, and follow-ups.

You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or train models from scratch. You should, however, be comfortable using modern AI tools thoughtfully, evaluating their output, and helping turn promising AI use cases into practical analytics workflows.

What You’ll Do

Business Intelligence, Reporting, and Insights
• Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytic tools using BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
• Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership to deliver insights that support business decisions.
• Analyze customer and user behavior across key product flows, including activation, conversion, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption.
• Identify product opportunities, funnel drop-offs, friction points, and performance trends using appropriate analytical techniques.
• Contribute to metric definition and performance tracking for new features, enhancements, partner initiatives, and business priorities.
• Automate recurring reporting and data workflows using SQL, dbt, and lightweight scripting such as Python, R, Google Apps Script, or similar tools.
• Support data quality, consistency, and reliability across reporting pipelines, data marts, and dashboards.
• Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that improve customer experience, product decisions, and business outcomes.

Product and Partner-Facing Analytics
• Deliver custom data solutions and insights to Peek’s business customers, including French-speaking customers where needed.
• Present findings, recommendations, and performance trends to internal stakeholders and external customers in both French and English.
• Support customer-facing analytics conversations by explaining data clearly, answering follow-up questions, and helping partners understand opportunities.
• Work closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Finance teams to enhance the revenue capabilities of Peek’s SaaS booking platform.
• Collaborate with data and software engineering teams to support the growth, accuracy, and reliability of Peek’s data warehouse, data models, and data marts.
• Assist in preparing and delivering analytics projects on time and at a high standard.

AI-Driven Analytics and Innovation
• Use modern AI tools and APIs, such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or comparable platforms, to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable workflows, and improve stakeholder self-service.
• Experiment with AI-enabled analytics use cases, including natural-language data exploration, automated insight summaries, data-quality checks, opportunity identification, and workflow routing.
• Help identify high-value business problems where AI can improve decision speed, reduce manual work, or uncover revenue and product opportunities.
• Measure the effectiveness of AI-enabled workflows using adoption, quality, efficiency, and business-impact metrics.
• Apply sound judgment around data privacy, accuracy, and human review; validate AI-generated insights before they inform decisions.
• Actively participate in Peek’s analytics community by sharing best practices, contributing to analytics forums, and staying current with analytics and AI trends.

What You Bring
• Business-level French and English proficiency is required for this role, including the ability to communicate effectively in professional, client-facing, and cross-functional business settings
• Comfort working in a client-facing capacity, including presenting insights, explaining analysis, and answering questions from business customers.
• 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, product analytics, data analytics

If you are unable to apply due to incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at talent@peek.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

job_title: Senior Data Analyst - French/English Proficiency Required
job_description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst – French/English Proficiency Required based in Canada. This is a data-driven role focused on turning complex information into actionable insights that improve products, customer experiences, and business performance. You will work across business intelligence, product analytics, partner-facing analytics, and AI-enabled workflows. The position offers broad exposure to Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership teams. You will also engage directly with business customers, presenting findings and recommendations in both French and English. Your work will help identify growth opportunities, improve funnels and engagement, strengthen reporting, and support better business decisions. You will combine analytical expertise with modern tools such as SQL, dbt, BI platforms, Python, and AI-powered technologies. This is an opportunity to contribute to an evolving analytics function where curiosity, clear communication, experimentation, and practical business impact are highly valued. Accountabilities: - Business Intelligence & Reporting: Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical tools using platforms such as Looker, Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, or similar technologies. - Business Insights: Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to deliver analysis that informs strategic and operational decisions. - Product Analytics: Analyze customer and user behavior across activation, conversion, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption to identify opportunities and performance trends.

- Funnel & Performance Analysis: Identify product opportunities, friction points, funnel drop-offs, and emerging trends using appropriate analytical methods, while contributing to metric definitions and performance tracking. - Reporting Automation: Automate recurring reports and data workflows using SQL, dbt, and lightweight scripting tools such as Python, R, Google Apps Script, or similar technologies. - Data Quality: Support the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting pipelines, data marts, dashboards, and underlying analytical data. - Partner-Facing Analytics: Develop custom data solutions and insights for business customers, including presenting findings, explaining analysis, answering questions, and identifying opportunities in both French and English. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Finance, Data, and Software Engineering teams to support analytics projects and improve the reliability and commercial value of data. - AI-Enabled Analytics: Use modern AI tools and APIs, including platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or comparable solutions, to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, and improve stakeholder self-service. - AI Experimentation & Validation: Explore use cases such as natural-language data analysis, automated insight generation, data-quality checks, opportunity identification, and workflow automation while validating AI outputs for accuracy, privacy, and business relevance. - Analytics Community: Share best practices, contribute to analytics initiatives and forums, and stay informed about emerging developments in data analytics and AI. Requirements - Professional Experience: 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related field. - Language Proficiency: Business-level fluency in both French and English is required, with the ability to communicate effectively in professional, cross-functional, and client-facing settings. - Client-Facing Skills: Comfortable presenting insights, explaining analytical findings, answering questions, and engaging directly with business customers.

Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role

• Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
• Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
• Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
• Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
• Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
• Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
• Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
• Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
• Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
• Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.

About You

• You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
• You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
• Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
• You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
• You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
• You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
• You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
• You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
• You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

job_title: Data and Business Intelligence Analyst, Intern (Fall 2026, 12 months)
job_description:
Your Role

Here’s what you will be doing:

• Support end-to-end Business Intelligence (BI) development by defining requirements and developing functional Power BI prototypes and production-ready reports.

• Build and maintain semantic data models for BI and AI applications using Python, SQL, Power Query, and DAX.

• Manage and configure Row-Level Security (RLS) and evaluate Object-Level Security (OLS) for sensitive data models.

• Apply modern UI/UX design principles to create intuitive, user-friendly reports and contribute to the development of the Hitachi Rail Power BI Toolkit.

• Contribute to AI and automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency within BI and engineering operations.

• Document data processing steps, manage testing and verification of reports, and prepare/host Gate Reviews for production releases.

• Analyze datasets for usability, propose improvements for data integrity, and support version control processes for Power BI reports.

• Provide technical support on Power BI and UI/UX design as needed.

• Develop Power BI report prototypes based on defined requirements when available.

About You

The company is looking for:

• A 4th or 5th year student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT program (Bachelor's or Master's) or equivalent experience.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, fluent in written and oral English.

• Experience developing Power BI reports, including proficiency in DAX and Power Query.

• Strong foundational knowledge of SQL or T-SQL for data querying and transformation.

• Experience or strong familiarity with Python for data processing, scripting, or automation.

• Familiarity with modern development environments such as VS Code and AI-assisted coding tools like GitHub Copilot.

• Knowledge of UI/UX principles and a strong analytical mindset focused on data transparency.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a hybrid work environment.

• Able to work full time (40 hours per week) for the agreed term with a minimum of 2 days (16 hours) in the Toronto office.

• Hourly pay ranging from $23 to $30 CAD.

• Paid internship with paid vacation.

• Hybrid work model.

• Mentorship through a Buddy Program.

• Access to real-world projects with industry professionals.

• Networking opportunities including "Ask Me Anything" sessions with the Executive Committee, Employee Resource Groups, social intern events, and company social events such as holiday parties and BBQs.

Training & Development

• Intern Orientation and Online Onboarding Curriculum.

• Mentorship via the Buddy Program.

• Opportunities to build career skills with a global leader in digital transformation and innovation.

Career Progression

The internship offers a chance to build a career with a global leader driving digital transformation and innovation that supports a sustainable future.

How to Apply

job_description:
EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

As a reputed company Intern, you will be working on projects gaining you valuable, real-world experience in a professional environment as it relates to your field of study. "Essential Functions Under close supervision, the successful candidate may assist with the following: project management, project planning, process mapping, data analysis, workflow documentation, learning design and development, engineering support (testing and design), and report automation Assist with technology industry research, global business intelligence, and emerging trends analysis. Present and deliver long-term solutions that will have significant impacts to the business and/or customer experience. Perform other duties as assigned." job_title: Data Scientst - Student Position - Sales Business Analytics
job_description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products—they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!

As a Data Scientist - Student Position, Sales Business Analytics in Apple's Sales organization, you'll play a key role in supporting our mission. Collaborating with Sales Professionals, Finance, Operations and Senior Leadership, you will deliver operational excellence by providing data insights, reporting, analytics, and tools to advance our strategic vision. We are searching for a student who can be flexible in the face of business ambiguity and eager to analyze/break down sophisticated datasets to derive clear decisions for our various business partners.

Please Note: This is a Limited Term Employment position (8-Month Co-op) from January to August 2027
Description

This program offers mentorship and development to elevate your business acumen and give visibility to a wide spectrum of business projects at Apple. You will be embedded within a Sales Data and Analytics team and will own deliverables end to end. Depending on team fit, your work will center on a subset of the following:

1. Data Pipeline Modernization and Observability

- Upgrade and modernize mature production ETL/ELT pipelines that span multiple platforms to ensure stability and reliability.

- Build and maintain automated batch pipelines that ingest, clean, and transform multi-source data into PostgreSQL and Snowflake environments.

- Stand up pipeline monitoring and observability: freshness checks, volume and schema drift detection, data quality assertions.

- Optimize database schemas, warehouse models, and query performance for analytical and AI workloads.

2. Workflow Orchestration and Tooling Migration

- Migrate scheduled jobs and legacy workflows into Apache Airflow and Apple's internal orchestration platforms, with a focus on avoiding silent failures during and after cutover.

- Document existing job dependencies and build validation and parallel-run strategies to confirm parity before decommissioning.

- Contribute to a catalog of modern Canada tooling and automations.

3. AI Agent Development and Evaluation

- Architect and build agentic workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and custom LLM applications against internal knowledge sources.

- Support the Canada AI Knowledge Hub and Skills Marketplace: knowledge base design, content structuring, retrieval quality, and the user-facing experience.

- Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI systems, including ground-truth sets, benchmark suites, and methods for detecting confidently incorrect answers and hallucinations.

- Build AI agents for cross-source data reconciliation and monitoring, resolving discrepancies where multiple systems of record disagree.

- Implement structured logging, caching, and fallback mechanisms so AI features behave predictably in production.

4. Analytics, Modeling, and Tiering

- Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and statistical modeling to uncover actionable insights.

- Develop and refine multi-factor scoring and tiering models (Business Tiering, POS Tiering, Carrier Analytics, and related frameworks) that combine several weighted inputs into a single classification.

- Build robust validation approaches and be prepared to explain and defend individual model outputs to business stakeholders as needed.

- Deliver reporting and visualization that makes model results usable, including Tableau dashboards and prepared datasets.

5. Data Governance and Enablement

- Contribute to data catalog and metadata efforts, including data lineage tracking and documentation of data requirements across sources.

- Curate and prepare datasets for business teams adopting AI tools, translating qualitative stakeholder needs into concrete metrics and data products.

- Support AI enablement activities such as office hours, documentation, and internal guidance.

6. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Impact

- Partner with business partners, peers, and IS&T to translate ambiguous problems into concrete data and AI deliverables.

- Write clean, well-documented, tested code; participate in code reviews; and present project milestones to both technical and executive stakeholders.
Minimum Qualifications
• Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related quantitative field, returning to studies after position’s term.
• Strong proficiency in Python and standard data libraries (pandas, NumPy).
• Strong command of SQL and relational database concepts, including experience with PostgreSQL & Snowflake or a comparable relational database.
• Hands-on experience building end-to-end data pipelines or applications through coursework, personal projects, hackathons, or prior internships.
• Experience with Git and collaborative version control workflows.
• Foundational understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering design.
• Demonstrated AI literacy: familiarity with how LLMs work, their failure modes, and where they are and are not appropriate.
• Strong communication and writing skills, critical to working across multiple teams and functions.
• Flexibility to juggle multiple responsibilities independently, and the judgment to ask questions early when something is unclear.
Preferred Qualifications

• Data Engineering and Orchestration
• Apache Airflow (or Prefect, Dagster) for workflow orchestration
• PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt
• Pipeline testing, data quality frameworks (Great Expectations or similar), and monitoring or alerting tooling
• Data lineage, metadata management, or data catalog tools
• AI and LLM Application Development
• LLM and agent frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, or native tool-use and agent frameworks
• RAG architecture, prompt engineering, and retrieval evaluation
• Agent evaluation and benchmarking, including LLM-as-judge methods and hallucination detection
• Vector search: pgvector, Chroma, Qdrant, or similar
• FastAPI, Docker, and asynchronous Python
• Data Science and Analytics
• Statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and feature engineering
• scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM for classification and scoring problems

• Clear technical documentation

job_title: PhD Data Scientist Intern: ML & Fraud Analytics
job_description:
Stripe, Inc. is seeking a data science intern in Canada to work on projects across the analytics stack.

You will own problems end to end with mentor support, collaborating with teams to extract insights from complex data and to build metrics, dashboards, and reports that inform business decisions. You’ll work with leading data scientists to develop predictive models and time-series analyses, applying statistical methods and causal inference designs to real-world problems.

EIC (Experience Internship Canada) is looking for new talent to join its teams as a Data Scientist / AI Intern.

In this role, you will actively contribute to the collection, analysis, and use of company data.

You will also work on designing, evaluating, and improving predictive models and artificial intelligence solutions, with real responsibilities from the start of your internship.

The experience takes place in Canada, in our Montreal, Toronto, or Vancouver offices.

You will discover a dynamic North American professional environment where efficiency, collaboration, autonomy, and initiative are central.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Data Scientist / AI Intern at EIC, you will play a key role in leveraging data and developing solutions that support better decision-making.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Data collection and preparation: extract, clean, structure, and consolidate data from different sources.
• Data analysis: produce analyses to identify trends, behaviors, and insights relevant to decision-making.
• Modeling: design, train, and improve predictive models adapted to business challenges.
• Machine learning: contribute to developing models and algorithms used to automate or improve analytical processes.
• Model evaluation: measure the performance, accuracy, and reliability of developed models.
• Model optimization: test different approaches and parameters to improve model results.
• Production deployment: contribute to integrating and deploying models into environments used by internal teams.
• Model monitoring: analyze model performance over time and identify potential drift or areas for improvement.
• Reporting and visualization: build dashboards and materials that clearly communicate analytical results.
• Data quality: monitor the consistency and reliability of the data used for analysis and modeling.
• Technology watch: monitor developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence tools and methods.
• Collaboration with EIC teams: work closely with technical, sales, marketing, and operations teams to address their analytical needs.
• Process optimization: contribute to automating analyses, reporting, and tracking tools.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
• You are currently studying data science, artificial intelligence, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field.
• You have a genuine interest in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence applications.
• You are comfortable using Python and data manipulation and analysis tools.
• You have knowledge of data science or machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent technologies.
• You understand the fundamental principles of model design, training, and evaluation.
• You are comfortable using SQL and working with databases.
• You are able to analyze results and draw relevant conclusions to address business challenges.
• You are rigorous, autonomous, organized, and comfortable solving complex problems.
• You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are interested in developing your skills in an international and multicultural environment.
• A good level of English may be required depending on the position and responsibilities.

WHY JOIN EIC?

Joining EIC means becoming part of a growing company and taking on a position with real professional and personal responsibilities.

You will have the opportunity to work with real datasets, develop and test models applied to concrete business challenges, and strengthen your skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in a professional environment.

It is also an opportunity to gain professional experience in Canada, discover North American working methods, and develop skills that are highly valued in the international job market.

BENEFITS
• Fixed salary
• Coaching and training in data science, machine learning, and analytics tools
• Access to real data and concrete business challenges
• Work on models and projects applied to real-world use cases
• Real responsibilities from the start of the internship
• Direct contact with North American companies
• Personalized guidance and support throughout the internship
• International professional experience in Canada
• Possibility of progressing into a long-term position depending on performance and the company’s needs

CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.
POSITION OVERVIEW

CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.
You will gain hands-on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES

• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.

• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.

• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de-identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.

• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.

• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.

• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.

• Support document classification and medical-legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Currently enrolled in a co-op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.

• Familiarity with core NLP or document-processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named-entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.

• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real-world data.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high-stakes information in accordance with established procedures.

• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.

• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public-sector, or other regulated-domain data is an asset.

• Familiarity with privacy-preserving data practices, including de-identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.

• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.

• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.

Company Description

Build bold. Deliver impact. Win together.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, we’re not just engineering technology — we’re shaping the future of defence and security. Our teams design and deliver advanced, mission-critical solutions that enhance national security, strengthen communities, and protect the people we serve.

If you’re looking for meaningful work that contributes to a safer, more secure world, you’ll find purpose here. Every day, your skills will directly impact programs that matter.

Job Description

In this role, students support the management, integration, and control of aircraft technical data, training data, and materiel information supporting a complex aviation defence program. These roles provide hands-on experience with aircraft data management, configuration control, logistics support, and lifecycle sustainment activities. Students gain exposure to mission-critical aircraft systems, Prime Mission Equipment (PME), training devices, and maintenance programs supporting aircraft acceptance, transition, and in-service support for Canada.

Key Responsibilities
• Support the management, review, and integration of aircraft technical data and supporting materials within approved record-keeping and configuration management systems.
• Assist project and engineering teams in collecting, controlling, and maintaining data required to support aircraft, Prime Mission Equipment (PME), training devices, and modification or repair activities.
• Contribute to logistics, materiel management, and lifecycle support activities, including the identification of required spares, support equipment, and sustainment data.
• Support coordination with internal teams, industry partners, and government stakeholders through participation in meetings, working groups, and documentation activities.
• Assist with the development and maintenance of training data, technical publications, and supporting documentation for aircraft and ground systems.
• Prepare and support the delivery of scheduled and ad hoc reports, data packages, and technical summaries.
• Support aircraft maintenance and airworthiness teams by managing data and documentation required for aircraft acceptance and transition to In-Service Support (ISS).

Qualifications

Required
• Currently enrolled in an avionics diploma, engineering program, or equivalent technical program at a Canadian college or university.
• Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, configuration control, and data integrity.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with minimal supervision.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Enthusiastic, willing to learn, and takes ownership of assigned work.

Assets
• Understanding of basic aircraft systems, maintenance programs, and airworthiness principles.
• Exposure to configuration management, data management, or technical documentation practices.
• Familiarity with logistics support, materiel management, or lifecycle sustainment concepts.
• Understanding of computer systems, RF communications, or information technology environments.
• Systems-thinking mindset, with the ability to view aircraft and support environments as a system of systems.
• Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
• Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred.

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

Additional Information

Compensation

The expected hourly rate for this position is $21.20 – $33.23. Final compensation will be determined based on your relevant work experience to date. As part of student placement, you will be eligible for quarterly pay increases.

Why Students Love Working Here
• Purposeful Innovation & Problem Solving: You’ll work alongside experienced professionals and some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, gaining hands-on experience with next-generation technologies. This is a place where your ideas are encouraged, creativity is valued, and you’ll be supported as you learn and help drive modern, practical solutions.
• Connection & Mentorship: Through onboarding to your career journey with us, you will work with teammates that are excited to share their experience and develop your skills. Have meaningful interactions, ask questions, and build relationships that can lead to lasting industry connections.

job_description:
About Hivery

HIVERY, officially formed in 2015, began with an advanced AI system built with bleeding edge technologies from machine learning, operations research, and design discipline. This system remains at the core of HIVERY to this day, and is continuously improved by an ever-expanding team of scientists, engineers, and designers as we pursue and develop our ultimate vision: The Retail Genome®.

We are a venture backed startup and closed series B funding in July 2022. HIVERY Curate, our flagship product, is the world’s only store-level assortment and space strategy simulation and optimization solution. HIVERY Curate enables a retailer or category manager to run assortment and category simulations and understand the financial impact of any assortment and space decision. Originally located in Sydney, Australia HIVERY is now a globally distributed organization hiring for remote roles in engineering.

We are seeking a new or recent graduate to join us as a Data Engineer in our Curate engineering team. In this role you will:

• Develop features and improvements to the HIVERY Curate product in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.

• Collaborate with Product and other stakeholders within Engineering to maintain a high bar for quality in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

• Solve technical problems of low to moderate scope and complexity.

• Write code that meets our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices for data engineering in a high scale environment. Maintain and advocate for these standards through code review

• Collaborate to identify impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions.

• Represent HIVERY and its values in public communication around specific projects and community contributions.

• Ship small features and improvements with guidance and support from senior team members.

• Participate on-call rotations

To be successful in this role you will need to have:

• Familiarity with object-oriented design patterns, data structures, and algorithms

• Professional or academic experience with Python or Go.

• Professional or academic experience with one or more cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and infrastructure as code.

• Professional or academic experience with data warehousing, ELT, or ELT

• Professional or academic experience with big data technologies such as Apache Hadoop, Spark, Iceberg

• Proficiency in the English language, both written and verbal, sufficient for success in a remote and asynchronous work environment.

• Excellent communication skills and a capability to communicate with both technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Experience with performance and optimization problems and a demonstrated ability to both diagnose and prevent these problems.

• Comfort working in a highly agile, intensely iterative software development process.

• Positive and solution-oriented mindset.

• Effective communication skills: Tactfully achieve consensus with peers, and clear status updates.

• An inclination towards communication, inclusion, and visibility.

• Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills.

• Share our values, and work in accordance with those values.

• Ability to thrive in a fully remote organization.

The pay range for this role is:

70,000 - 80,000 CAD per year(Remote - Canada)

Quel que soit votre niveau d'expérience, vous serez jumelé à un coach pour accélérer votre évolution professionnelle dans un environnement où nous bâtissons l'avenir, maintenant.

Les Avantages De Vous Joindre à Nous

• Pour apprendre en continu : un accès au capital intellectuel d’IBM et à des formations sur une multitude de technologies de pointe.
• Pour votre bien-être : un ensemble d’assurances collectives y compris un service de télémédecine, un régime d’épargne retraite avec contribution de l'employeur, des actions IBM à un tarif avantageux, prestations parentales supplémentaires et une allocation mieux-être !

Dans le cadre de la croissance de notre pratique Hybrid Cloud & Data (AI, Analytics & Data Services), nous sommes à la recherche d’un Junior to Intermediate Data Engineer – Hybrid Cloud & Data afin de contribuer au développement et à l’évolution de solutions modernes de données.

Sous la supervision d’architectes et d’ingénieurs Data expérimentés, le titulaire participera à la conception, au développement et au support de pipelines de données permettant aux organisations d’exploiter leurs informations pour l’analytique, la prise de décision et l’intelligence artificielle.

• Participer aux revues de code et aux pratiques de développement.
• Documenter les solutions développées.
• Développer progressivement une expertise en architecture Data moderne.

• Participer au développement de pipelines de données.
• Effectuer l’extraction, la transformation et le chargement des données (ETL/ELT).
• Développer des scripts et composants de traitement de données.
• Effectuer des validations de qualité des données.
• Corriger les problèmes liés aux traitements et aux intégrations.

Participer à Des Projets Utilisant

• Microsoft Azure
• Microsoft Fabric
• Azure Data Factory
• Azure Data Lake Storage
• Azure Databricks
• Power BI
• Azure SQL

Contribuer à Des Architectures Modernes

• Data Lakehouse
• Data Warehouse
• Medallion Architecture
• Data Integration

Votre Expérience

• Diplôme universitaire ou collégial en informatique, génie logiciel, science des données ou domaine connexe.
• 1 à 5 ans d’expérience pertinente
• Connaissances SQL
• Notions Python
• Concepts de bases de données relationnelles
• Compréhension des concepts ETL/ELT
• Connaissance des environnements Cloud (atout)
• Connaissance Power BI ou outils BI (atout)
• Connaissance Azure Data Services (atout)

Vous Vous Démarquez Par Votre

• Intérêt marqué pour les données, le Cloud et l’intelligence artificielle.
• Curiosité technologique et volonté d’apprentissage.
• Capacité à travailler en équipe.
• Bonne capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
• Bilinguisme en français et en anglais, car vous serez amené à collaborer avec des ressources à l'extérieur du Québec.

Pourquoi joindre notre équipe

Vous aurez l’opportunité de développer votre expertise auprès d’experts Data, Cloud et AI et de contribuer à des projets modernes utilisant les technologies les plus recherchées du marché.

job_description:
Growth & Commercial Analyst (Grid Services)

The Company

Powerhouse Generation (PHG) is a leading energy management and Demand Side Unit (DSU) aggregator operating across the all-island electricity market. We act as a virtual power station, connecting large commercial, industrial, and institutional energy users, such as manufacturing plants, hospitals, and commercial facilities, directly to the power grid. By optimising real-time electricity demand and enabling remote grid balancing, we empower our clients to unlock new revenue streams, reduce carbon impacts, and contribute to a more stable, sustainable energy grid.

Strategic Context

Powerhouse Generation’s growth agenda includes converting the iSEM sales pipeline into contracted MW capacity for the 2027/28 capacity year, expanding existing customer relationships, progressing new industrial and energy-intense customers, and building a repeatable pipeline for subsequent years. The role must keep near-term contract conversion on track while supporting longer-term growth opportunities. The individual is not simply responsible for producing reports: they are expected to drive actions and help opportunities progress.

The Role

This is a high-impact role for an ambitious commercial analyst or business development professional who wants broad exposure to strategy, customers, energy markets and executive decision-making. Success means the CGO has better information, more time with strategic customers, fewer stalled actions and a materially higher probability of delivering PHG’s contracted MW and growth objectives.

The Purpose To act as the Chief Growth Officer’s commercial wingman, turning PHG’s growth strategy into a controlled programme of customer acquisition, contracted capacity, revenue and EBITDA growth. The role combines commercial analysis, account and pipeline management, project coordination and executive-level reporting. It is designed to increase the CGO’s capacity to win and expand strategic accounts by ensuring that opportunities are properly analysed, actions are followed through, internal blockers are surfaced early, and decisions are supported by reliable data.

Key responsibilities

• Growth plan and execution

Translate the CGO’s growth priorities into a practical action plan with milestones, owners, dependencies and decision dates.

Maintain a clear view of contracted MW, forecast MW, probability-weighted pipeline, revenue and EBITDA implications where data is available.

Track progress against monthly targets and identify slippage, gaps and corrective actions early.

Coordinate cross-functional actions required to move opportunities from initial discussion through proposal, heads of terms, contract and readiness for registration/qualification.

Prepare concise decision papers and recommendations for the CGO and executive team.

• Commercial pipeline and account management

Own the accuracy and discipline of the growth pipeline, including stage, validated MW, customer sponsor, next action, close date, capacity year and probability.

Prepare for and coordinate weekly pipeline reviews; record decisions, owners and deadlines, and chase actions through to completion.

Develop account plans for priority customers and support the CGO with customer research, stakeholder maps, meeting briefs and follow-up notes.

Support multi-site and group-level commercial propositions, standardised site schedules, proposals, term sheets and framework agreements.

Identify stalled deals, understand the blocker, coordinate a recovery plan and recommend when an opportunity should be re-scoped, re-priced, re-timed or closed.

Support early-stage qualification of prospects by collecting site data, validating potential MW and coordinating technical/commercial assessment.

• Market, data and commercial analysis

Analyse customer sites, flexibility potential, operating profiles, available capacity and relevant market routes in coordination with PHG’s technical and markets specialists.

Build and maintain commercial models, opportunity comparisons and sensitivities covering MW, revenue, costs, margin and EBITDA where inputs are available.

Research target sectors and accounts, including industrial and energy-intense customers, data centres, battery energy storage and other relevant flexibility assets.

Track relevant market developments, customer investment plans and regulatory/market changes that may affect PHG’s proposition; flag implications rather than provide unsupported conclusions.

Challenge assumptions and data quality, distinguish verified facts from estimates, and make uncertainty visible in forecasts.

• Contracting and delivery coordination

Coordinate the commercial workflow from proposal to signed agreement, working with legal, finance, technical and delivery colleagues.

Maintain a live list of contract, funding, technical, metering, registration and qualification dependencies for priority sites.

Ensure site capacity, expected availability date and capacity-year assumptions are reconciled before an opportunity is counted as deliverable.

Support preparation of customer and internal approval packs and keep a record of decisions and outstanding conditions.

Escalate risks that could prevent a site from meeting the relevant qualification or go-live deadline.

• Executive support and operating rhythm

Prepare a short weekly growth dashboard and monthly executive scorecard.

Create concise customer meeting briefs, presentation materials, board/executive updates and follow-up action logs.

Maintain a single source of truth for pipeline data until a CRM or other system is implemented.

Organise growth review meetings and ensure the CGO’s time is focused on the decisions, relationships and negotiations with the greatest impact.

Handle commercially sensitive information with discretion and maintain high standards of accuracy and confidentiality.

WhatWe’reLookingFor

Essential

Strong analytical and commercial skills, with confidence working with data, forecasts and business cases.

Excellent Excel skills; able to build and maintain structured models, dashboards and trackers. PowerPoint proficiency is also required.

Strong project coordination and follow-through: able to manage multiple opportunities, deadlines, dependencies and stakeholders.

Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex information into concise executive summaries.

Commercial judgement, curiosity and confidence to question assumptions, identify gaps and escalate risks constructively.

Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

Discretion when handling customer, contract, pricing and company information.

Willingness to learn the Irish and Northern Irish energy markets, flexibility services and relevant capacity/qualification processes.

Must have a full driver’s licence and own travel.

Desirable

Experience in energy, utilities, demand response, energy aggregation, flexibility, generation, BESS or industrial energy management.

Experience supporting business development, key accounts, commercial contracts or strategic growth programmes.

Familiarity with financial modelling, revenue/margin analysis, CRM tools and pipeline forecasting.

Experience coordinating technical, commercial, legal and operational teams.

Relevant degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, economics, engineering, energy or data analytics.

Personal attributes A self-starter who anticipates what the CGO will need next.

Commercially assertive without overstepping decision authority.

Comfortable engaging with customers and senior internal stakeholders.

Practical and delivery-oriented: values signed contracts and completed actions over activity for its own sake.

Able to work independently, maintain attention to detail and keep momentum across a broad portfolio.

Location

Ireland / Northern Ireland, with travel to customer sites as required

Private medical insurance

Company pension

Company social events

Gym on site

Parking on site

Additional days leave

Bike to work scheme

Escalate risks that could prevent a site from meeting the relevant qualification or go-live deadline.

Create concise customer meeting briefs, presentation materials, board/executive updates and follow-up action logs.

Maintain a single source of truth for pipeline data until a CRM or other system is implemented.

Organise growth review meetings and ensure the CGO’s time is focused on the decisions, relationships and negotiations with the greatest impact.

Handle commercially sensitive information with discretion and maintain high standards of accuracy and confidentiality.

Strong analytical and commercial skills, with confidence working with data, forecasts and business cases.

Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex information into concise executive summaries.

Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

Experience coordinating technical, commercial, legal and operational teams.

Commercially assertive without overstepping decision authority.

Join to apply for the Supply Chain Analyst role at Gastops.

Over the last 40 years, Gastops has built a robust business which is recognized worldwide for its innovative contributions to equipment health management in the aviation, energy, marine, industrial and transportation industries. Gastops' products and services add value throughout the life cycle of complex critical equipment from the design stage through to in-service operations and support. We design, manufacture, and support advanced equipment sensing and analysis products, including on-line oil debris sensors, torque measurement sensors, turbine blade health sensors, and at-line oil analysis systems.

As a Supply Chain Analyst at Gastops, you will play a key role in optimizing our supply chain operations through data-driven insights and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) leadership. You will be responsible for analyzing procurement and logistics data, developing performance reports, and supporting cross-functional teams to enhance efficiency and decision-making across the supply chain. You will also serve as the functional lead for ERP-related supply chain processes, ensuring system integrity and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

• Data Analysis & Reporting • Analyze supply chain data (inventory, procurement, lead times, supplier performance, etc.) to identify trends, variances, and areas for improvement.
• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track KPIs and support strategic decision-making.
• Collaborate with operations, finance, and engineering teams to gather requirements and provide data-driven insights.

• ERP System Leadership • Serve as the functional lead for ERP systems related to supply chain processes (e.g., procurement, inventory, BOMs, production planning).
• Maintain data integrity in ERP systems and lead initiatives to improve automation and data accuracy.
• Support ERP upgrades, configuration changes, and training for supply chain users.

• Process Improvement • Assist in the development and implementation of best practices for procurement, material planning, and inventory control.
• Work with stakeholders to identify inefficiencies and develop solutions to improve overall supply chain performance.

• Supplier & Inventory Management • Support supplier evaluation through performance metrics and risk analysis.
• Assist with inventory optimization strategies, including safety stock levels and reorder points.

• Operational Support • Support other supply chain functions, such as shipping, receiving, inventory control, material planning, and procurement, as needed.
• Assist in managing cycle counts, physical inventory, and reconciliation processes.

Who You Are:
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or operations analysis role.
• Proficient with ERP systems (e.g., Epicor, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
• Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, charts, etc.).
• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is an asset.
• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities.
Preferred:
• Experience in a manufacturing or engineering-based environment, ideally in aerospace, defence, or energy sectors.
• Experience with Epicor Kinetic ERP system.
• Familiarity with ISO, AS9100, or other regulated environments.
• Understanding of Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement.
What We Offer You:
• Competitive salary, benefits, profit share bonus program
• A fantastic culture, team, and energy to work with
• Superb work location in Ottawa (Canotek Business Park)
• Social activities, company-sponsored events and opportunities to give back to our local community
Gastops is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to acquiring a skilled and diverse workforce. Not just another entry level career opportunity: receive coaching, mentorship, and support at every step of your career journey. We invest in you so you can thrive and succeed.

Launch your tech career with FDM – any degree welcomed

Your degree got you here, your passion can take you further. Start a tech career that’s both dynamic and impactful. As an FDM Consultant, you’ll get the chance to work with global companies across banking, consulting, retail, insurance, and more. You’ll add big names to your resume and gain hands-on experience from day one.

Serving a wide variety of industries, we can offer our consultants a career path in their most suited field. We help you develop and build on your strengths, behaviors, knowledge, and ability with hands-on, industry relevant coaching, and place you on assignments with leading global companies.

We match your strengths to the right role. Opportunities could include, but not limited to:

Bridge business needs with technical solutions by collaborating closely with architects, engineers, and product teams. As a BSA, you’ll translate requirements into clear user stories, define acceptance criteria, support testing strategies, and validate solutions through hands‑on analysis. You’ll help refine processes, troubleshoot issues, and ensure systems and features are built, tested, and delivered with quality, all while working in an agile, fast‑moving environment.

Business Analyst

Analyze systems, processes, and data to uncover insights and recommend improvements that help businesses operate more efficiently and make informed decisions.

Project Manager

Plan and deliver projects on time and within scope, managing risks, budgets, and stakeholder expectations to ensure business goals are met.

What’s in it for you?
• Fast-track your career with 6-12 weeks initial upskilling courses facilitated by our expert coaches, followed by practice-based learning catered to industry demand
• Opportunity to work on exciting, business-critical projects with top-tier companies in banking & finance, insurance, retail, and more
• Dive into delivering solutions across the application lifecycle
• No tech experience? No problem. If you’re a logical thinker with strong research skills and a knack for clear communication, we’ll equip you with the tools to thrive in Change & Transformation
• With hands-on support and real client projects, you’ll be assignment-ready — and can grow into senior roles in just a few years
• Build a diverse and rewarding career path with ongoing coaching through our Skills Lab
• Consultant Experience Team to support your wellbeing, health, and happiness
• Potential to qualify for relocation support

What we look for
• You hold a university degree level (bachelor or higher)
• Able to commit to at least two years of employment with FDM as a consultant following the initial training period
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, paired with great interpersonal and communication skills
• Background with Excel, SQL or data visualization tools
• Eligible to work in Canada
• Please note that all client assignments will require on-site work in client offices. Office locations may include, but are not limited to, Toronto, Montreal, Halifax, Waterloo, Calgary and Vancouver

During the initial period of upskilling, all hours worked will be compensated at the rate of $18.35/hour. Once on client assignment, the compensation for this position is $50,000 annually and this role may also be eligible for participation in FDM's bonus scheme.

FDM powers the people behind tech and innovation. We spot trends, find top talent, and help businesses stay ahead.

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Canada's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance) Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

BCLC exists to generate win-wins for the greater good.

For our people, our players, our communities, our industry, and our planet.

Lottery | Casino | Sports

Being a social purpose company, we are not only able to better align our business decisions with our purpose, but more importantly, we are committing to doing our part in creating a better world.

We bring our purpose to life by ensuring all our actions, behaviours and decisions create benefits for communities and the planet.

Motivated and guided by our social purpose, everything we do must benefit the greater good. And we encourage our employees, partners, players, industry and communities to engage with us on this ambition.

We want you to be where you feel you can do your best work. Most of our jobs can be done remotely providing you reside in BC.

For those who prefer working in a community with others, we have two beautiful offices in convenient locations:

• 2940 Virtual Way, Vancouver
• 74 Seymour Street W, Kamloops

This is a Temporary < 12 Months, Full Time opportunity with an approximate duration of 8 months

Expected Salary Range: $87,530.00 - $109,414.00 - $136,768.00

• Our typical hiring range will be +/- 5% of the midpoint shown above

The Company

For nearly four decades, BCLC has delivered exceptional gambling entertainment for British Columbians. To fulfill our social purpose we have a vision to revolutionize gambling entertainment through engaging experiences that build and benefit communities. We operate national and provincial lotteries in partnership with 3500 retail partners, provide the games, technology & oversight to 37 brick & mortar casinos, and operate a safe secure and 100% legal online gambling presence PlayNow.com. In our recently completed fiscal year, BCLC generated a record $1.4 billion in net income to the Province of B.C. to support First Nations, host local governments, health care, education and community programs across the province.

Summary

Job Summary:

The Product Owner works under the guidance of their manager to lead the mission of the internal Agile product team. This role is responsible for defining the mission of the team and bringing the vision to the product team. The Product Owner collaborates with key stakeholders to deliver product requirements and maintain close interaction with the Agile product teams, key business stakeholders, enterprise enablement teams and supporting capability pods to ensure alignment.

• (With guidance from their leader,) Defines and manages the product backlog collaborating with stakeholder groups across the organization to understand the business strategy and determine priorities.

• Evaluates the outputs on behalf of stakeholders, including user acceptance of final product.
• Engages specialists across the organization, or contractors, in addition to product team members.
• Facilitates cross-functional workshops to drive decisions and consensus across functional areas.
• (With guidance from their leader,) negotiates with leaders and other stakeholders to remove team impediments, issues, and blockers, including escalating to the appropriate levels within the organization when they cannot be resolved at the team level.
• Collaborates with other product owners on the prioritization of cross-team dependencies and deliverables required by other product teams.
• Reports to stakeholders on the progress and status of product team deliverables. Proactively identifies risks and opportunities and makes recommendations for resolution.
• Identifies risks related to their specific area and works with stakeholders and leadership as needed to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies and reports on risks.

Education and Experience

• A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology Management or a related discipline;
• 4 to 6 years of relevant experience as well as experience in a leadership capacity;
• An equivalent combination of education and/or experience may be considered.

Technical Requirements

• Demonstrated ability to build strong and trusting relationships with managers, employees and peers;
• Able to interpret and translate ambiguous situations into structured and clearly defined deliverables;
• Excellent business and technical acumen;
• Excellent time management, organizational and multi-tasking skills to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups or activities;
• Proven ability to lead technical projects and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, providing technical guidance;
• Strong technical writing skills, and able to write reports and document procedures;
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with an ability to communicate and address issues at all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders;
• Understanding of Agile methodology or experience working with a cross-functional team environment;
• Understanding of B.C. gaming industry would be an asset.

• Robust wellness programs to enhance your physical, mental, social, financial and career well being

• Our Play It Forward program provides volunteer hours for our people each year

WHO WE ARE

At Air Canada Vacations, we’re in the business of making dreams travel. That’s why we offer vacation packages, tours, cruises and more tailored to everyone’s individual needs. We like to say we have a vacation for every traveller because we do!

If you're someone who's passionate about exploring the world and sharing that enthusiasm with our customers, we'd love to welcome you to our team.

For over 50 years, Air Canada Vacations has been making travel easy, so come and join us in helping fellow Canadians create unforgettable memories wherever they go.

Don’t miss this opportunity! Submit your application by October 30, 2026 to be considered for this exciting opportunity.

JOB TITLE: Data Analyst Developer

POSITION STATUS: Permanent – Full Time

DEPARTMENT: IT - Operations

LOCATION : Montréal or Mississauga

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Reporting to the Lead Data Analyst Developer, the Data Analyst Developer primary function is to participate in the analysis, development, integration and automation of various data pipelines and data infrastructure within the ecosystem of Air Canada Vacations. The Data Analyst Developer is also to support the Data Architect in the transformation of Air Canada Vacation into an agile, cloud centric organization, targeting a replatforming toward a data lake/lake house based environment

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain Data Pipelines to move and transform data in a medallion based data lake / lake house architecture.
• Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle including design, development, testing, documentation, quality assurance support and maintenance.
• Adhere to design, coding, testing and change control best practices including version control, code review, user acceptance tests, observability/operationalization and documentation.
• Analyse business requirements with the users and design/implement systems or modifications to meet those requirements.
• Provide third level support for data infrastructure and data transformation pipelines.
• Take an active role in the implementation of Proof Of Concepts to confirm, reinforce or validate technological decisions.
• Create and maintain Technical Specifications documents relating to data pipelines.
• Develop and maintain operational reports.
• Support the BI team in the implementation and maintenance of the semantic layer.

Training/Certification/Experience
